Crime journalist and criminologist, Donal MacIntyre, meets former Detective Chief Inspector Sue Hill to discover how she solved the case of serial killer Daniel Gonzales in London.
New Scotland Yard detectives open their files to tell the inside stories of how they caught some of the capitals most notorious killers.
Jayden Parkinson was just 17 when she vanished shortly before Christmas. What follows is the unravelling of a toxic, coercive relationship with Ben Blakeley.

Following an insect mishap, Clarence's house needs to be fumigated, forcing Mary, Chad, and Clarence into a motel. It's the end of the school year, and Papa Mariano is slated to dish out his famous pizza along with a song and dance spectacle.
A broken VHS tape needs to be fixed. Mordecai and Rigby want a burger with a special ingredient.
During a fight between Batman, Robin and Clayface, Birdarang and Batarang take the Batmobile and go partying in the city.

BMO tries to play matchmaker to two bugs, but Finn and Jake crash the plan with their own ideas about romance, putting the budding love story at risk. When Finn brings Jake to his favourite childhood dungeon, they're underwhelmed.

A compilation of some of the funniest, most bizarre clips uploaded onto the internet by the people of Elmore. When Rob purchases a universal remote from the Awesome Store, he discovers he can control the universe and rewinds into the past.

Bean has to deal with an unwanted house guest, but the stubborn pest refuses to leave. Bean tries to be romantic but his idea of what that means proves very different to Irma's. Mr Bean enters a competition for food.
What is a teen superhero's everyday life when the cape comes off? Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg deal with the usual issues of adolescence while trying to save the world.

When Mr Bean becomes a scoutmaster for a day, his fixation on collecting badges fails to endear him to others. Mr Bean's obsession with his favourite TV programme, Super Spy, leads him to take his snooping activities to excessive lengths.

Muscle Man makes a song for Starla and tries to get it playing on his favourite radio station. Rigby and Mordecai participate in a donut eating contest for a chance to feature in their favourite police show.

Finn is forced to undertake a series of tough trials to claim a book meant for righteous heroes. Also, Finn and Jake take a tiny robot home to be their pet.

Gumball has a penchant for getting into trouble, but he never learns his lesson. Gumball's best friend is a fish named Darwin, who used to be the family pet until he grew legs and became part of the family.

Gumball and Nicole vow revenge on the driver of a car that cut them off. Gumball and Darwin find a diary and race to help its author before she misses a life-changing moment.

Twelve-year-old Finn and his magical dog, Jake, roam the Land of Ooo to right wrongs, battle evil and help bizarre characters in need of unique assistance.

When Grandpa Louie gives them a cheque, the Watterson kids argue over how to spend the money. Gumball sets out to prove to Penny's father that he's good enough for his daughter. After they receive an extravagant invitation to Masami's birthday party, Gumball and Darwin are anxious to find just the right gift for her. However, they're not the only ones. Dad discovers that Granny Jojo and Louie plan to get married and move to Florida.

When Anais reveals that she's in the grade above them at school, Gumball and Darwin's eyes are suddenly opened to a whole new world of other students at Elmore Junior High. When Gumball and Darwin decide it's time they join a crew, they agree that the coolest posse in Elmore is the Senior Citizens. Gumball and Darwin discover that Rob, who once swore to wreak vengeance on them, has been trying to destroy them for some time.
Prince Ivandoe and Bert set off on their heroic quest, and almost immediately, a winged serpent steals their map to Eagle Mountain. A fire-breathing Giant Chicken is terrorising the local farmers.
Join the CBBC crew for all your favourite programmes. Tune into CBBC every day from 7.00am.

Bitzer discovers Shaun watching old home movies in the barn. He joins him to share some fond memories of life on the farm. However, they don't like everything they see. Things get heated as the pair try to outdo each other by showing embarrassing clips from each other's past. Is this the end of a beautiful friendship?
When an old enemy returns, Colonel K must come out of retirement to save the world from an outbreak of rudeness.
The heroes are lured away by a cloaked figure to compete for the title of 'Quester of the Year', leaving the forest with no one to protect its scones.

With the rest of the gang sick with colds, Mouse builds himself his own personal transparent bubble to keep himself healthy. But soon the others also get their bubbles to enjoy their own space, even if they're not sick any more.
News magazine keeping young viewers up to date with the latest stories and events happening at home and abroad.
While Grizzy goes fishing, the Lemmings transform the cabin into a giant ice slide.
Grizzy swipes a magic statue from the Lemmings that has the ability to make desired objects appear in real life from a photo.
Mr. Krabs has a holiday and makes Larry the Lobster the temporary manager of the Krusty Krab.
Duck and Frog must move a famous pop star's possessions from one mansion to another.
Duck is working overnight in a museum and creates a Frankenstein Frog to keep him company.
Omni and Onom must track down a mysterious creature with a peculiar habit; Orli has to help new recruit Osric complete his training.
What if you could turn things to gold? We show you that it might not work out that well.
Mr Smith shows 9- to 11-year-olds how to place positive and negative numbers.

There is public confusion when King Charles II bans coffee shops and a seasick chicken ruins a Roman sea battle. Later, mighty Egyptian Pharaoh, Ramesses II, meets some smelly peasants on Historical Wife Swap, and a cave-dwelling Stone Age couple try to buy their first house.

Naturalist Steve Backshall has travelled the world in search of animals for his Deadly 60 list. Many of the animals he has encountered are armed and highly dangerous. This programme looks back at some of Steve's favourite creatures whose jaws, claws, venom and speed prove to be very useful weapons in the battle of the wild.

The doctors reveal how the pancreas keeps blood sugar levels in check, and they find out what it's like to be the hospital postman in Operation Takeover. Dr Xand investigates how scientists make Bioglass to help doctors mend damaged bones.
Prepare for some monster truck mayhem and very clever canines.

They follow a group of top scientists and explorers to find out how icebergs are born and what happens to them before they melt and disappear. They arrive at Store Glacier in Greenland, a gigantic 400m kilometre river of ice that releases 15 billion tonnes of ice into the sea each year as icebergs.
Twelve-year-old Annabell loves the seaside but lives in Milton Keynes, miles from the coast. She would like her very own beach den where she can spend time with friends and relax.
Find out if super-sized anaconda Optimus Prime welcomes his new housemate. Tyler tries to out-jump a springy serval cat, and Amur leopard Xizi has a big operation.
It's a battle of the houses, as the students compete to clock up the most exercise in one month. Last year's winner, Celeste, faces stiff competition from sporty Sophie.
Can under-15s defender Sol lead his team to victory in The Floodlit Cup? Can Konan bounce back with a little help from family?
When a school of flying fish accidentally make off with a rare book belonging to Professor Inkling, the Octonauts rig up the Gup-B to fly after them and get it back.
On an exciting trip around planet Proxima, Cosima and Big Lizard record some cosmic nature sounds for Dad.
After Pancake saves him from a mishap, Flutter vows to repay the debt. But his risk-averse behaviour drives Pan to distraction until a real emergency allows the debt to be repaid.
Wizz meets an alien who is trying to escape galactic consequences.
Frog makes the perfect farm scarecrow but then gets covered in super strong fertiliser.

After her siblings accidentally insult her dreams of being a pop star, Cheese is bonked on the head and starts to believe she's a huge celebrity. Mouse says they all must play along, because there's a chance Cheese could go bonkers.
Jordan and Layla have issues. Ashton hears Levi has a crush. Kenzie worries about her job.

Steve Backshall has encountered some incredible animals on his search around the planet for his Deadly 60. All the animals that made it onto Steve's list are deadly in their own right, but a handful of them are deadly to humans. This programme looks at those animals in detail, dispelling myths and showing just how incredible they truly are.
When a chicken ends up inside Shaun's pillowcase, Shaun tries to get it back, only for the chicken to end up in the farmhouse and the Farmer to think he is being haunted.
Walter and Dennis go head-to-head in a sponsored silence. Being quiet doesn't come naturally to either of them, as they struggle to make it through a chaotic school day and keep schtumm.
Danger Mouse's plan to hold a surprise party for Professor Squawkencluck is undone when the Baron releases killer birthday presents into the world.
The heroes quest to keep a two-headed dragon away.
The siblings unite to prepare an awesome Christmas surprise for their parents, but their efforts are thwarted every step of the way.
After the Yeti's house is destroyed, the Lemmings are quick to point the finger at Grizzy.
Duck is washing pots in a café, but his need for perfection is holding things up.
Can Duck's new job at the observatory help Frog watch a football game?
When the bulb in Breadcrumbs's vivarium fails, Pablo is so concerned that he slips into a semi-dormant state (like a lizard) to conserve energy until order can be restored.
A lake in Gruselbrook has turned red overnight. Could demonic forces be at play?
Everyone in the hutch is having pickled dreams, and an alien declares war on the world.

Lindsey, Richie and Henry the dog welcome a brand-new presenter to 'Blue Peter'. On their first show, the 39th presenter is thrown straight into a dance challenge; former BP stars share their top tips. Plus, find out all about them through a very special animation.

Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the marvellous Cabbage and his dazzling super veggie memory skills.
Coco shows Bing how to do fantastic big boos, and together they make Flop jump. When Bing tries out his new tricks on Charlie he finds out the power of boo has to be scaled down for babies.

As the Teletubbies say eh-oh to their reflections in a puddle, Dipsy's hat falls in and gets wet. Dipsy sings a sad song, but then the sun shines and the wind blows, and his hat is dry again in no time.
Tee enjoys his time in the paddling pool and doesn't want to get out. Can Mo lure him out of it with the promise of a warm bath?
Colour explorer Brown arrives in Colour land. Learn about the colour brown with the Colour blocks.
Mum tries to get Robo Bingo to clean its teeth with very specific instructions.

Sula and Bing are camping in Bing's garden in order to see the stars and the moon. As Flop goes back for Hoppity, night-time noises seep from the dark garden, spooking Bing. Then, a scary shape on the tent terrifies him. They go inside, but the monster has followed them in! Bing and Sula discover that Flop is the monster. So they go back outside, where the billion, zillion stars and a huge moon are waiting for them.
Nori and Preston are creating a circle of standing stones, like the ancients of Swoppiton used to make. The stones are big - will it take more than Mojo's crane top to move them?

The Squirrels have made a song and Duggee suggests they create a music video to accompany it that tells a story. There is a lot to prepare beforehand, and Enid gives a star performance in her own dreamy music video.

Duggee and the Squirrels set off on a warm-up run together as the Squirrels are feeling sleepy, but are told that a bit of exercise will wake them up. They learn how others like to exercise, and the benefits that you gain from it.
Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.
Mum bans the girls from saying the word 'dunny' because it's not a word the Queen of England would use, but the kids try and trick her into saying it anyway.
Searching for a jewel in India, Kym discovers that the Taj Mahal is the treasure itself and must stop Grandmaster Glitch from damaging it.
Peter, Lily and Benjamin race to rescue Cotton-tail's beloved blanket, escape Mr Tod and get back home before a brewing storm finally breaks.
The Octonauts expand their exploration beyond the sea and onto land. With new rides and new friends, they are prepared to protect any habitats and animals at risk on land or underwater.
Numberblocks Six to Ten sing about parts and wholes, and the numbers they have inside.
The Printing Crew help Dark Red and Green make lots of copies of their poster.
Love Monster and Bad Idea Puppy are getting ready to jam on Jam Session Day, but before they can start, Bad Idea Puppy realises that he needs the bathroom.
Justin's House has had a makeover. Robert has redecorated the house. Justin loves it but, after a scooter disco inside, he accidentally creates all sorts of mess.
We are making music! Ha! Ha!, we are making music!

Bing has broken his arm and is struggling to do his usual activities. Petting Arlo hurts, playing with blocks hurts, and even drinking juice hurts. But when Bing and Sula draw together it doesn't hurt.

Dee encourages a friend to say 'top' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see a red top, a blue top and a new top. There's a soft top, a scratchy top and Dee and a friend discover they have matchy tops. We meet a cool top, see lots of kids in school tops and there's even a tiger top.
One wet day, Sid and others try to shake up Tralala's gloomy mood by singing in the rain.
Eager to impress her dad, Mae sells an umbrella promised to another customer. When things erupt into troll-sized chaos, Mae, proving her troll strength, helps reveal the real problem.
In a game of hide-and-seek, Kiri pretends to be a flower.
The Twirlywoos find themselves in an office. They spin the office chairs round and round.
Justin meets some musical friends, and they put on a concert. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble is the judge of "Tumbleton's Got Talent" starring Grandad Tumble, Lord Tumble and Aunt Polly.
Po eats Tubby Custard and gets a messy bib. Po washes the bib clean and hangs it out to dry before eating more Tubby Custard with Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa.

Nigel and Baby Bear welcome babies Marta, Ferne, Inam, Isaac, Luther, Hawa and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside everyone's bags are porridge oats which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby appropriate porridge oats inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal.
Elsie plays I Spy with her friend Bailey in his back garden.
Maddie and Triggs help Mum babysit their delightfully cute, little neighbour Sally.

Murphy is in the middle of a mega clean-up in the attic, but he can't find Rebecca's lost hat. His magic cleaning machine goes wrong and causes mayhem, but it does give him a monster make idea - a paper banana skin! The Mini Monsters create wonderful scrap bag monsters, while Rebecca's grandpa tries to create a new ice cream flavour and a dreamy creamy sundae. The Recycling Express brings an old box with a window, which Murphy and Rebecca transform into a terrific box truck.

Crocky has got his foot stuck in a bucket, which makes lots of noise every time he walks. It's great fun making lots of noise at first, but soon Crocky tires of the bucket stuck on his foot. How can Raa Raa and the other jungle animals help Crocky remove the bucket?
Bluey goes to Mum for advice about pesky neighbours when her couch cushion playhouse is threatened by Bingo's huge stable of animals.

Duggee is reading the Squirrels one of his favourite comics. They are eager to know the ending, but the comic was discontinued. Luckily, Duggee has the comic badge, so he can show the Squirrels how to create their own ending.

Carys wants to find out all about jellyfish. Chantelle visits an aquarium which is home to some rather special jellyfish, whilst Rory meets a marine expert, and they head out to sea on a glass-bottomed boat. Chantelle and Rory's fact files help answer all of Carys's questions.

George and Freddie love having fun. After a hearty breakfast, they fill their day with family 'eggsperiments', art and even set up an obstacle course for Mum and Dad to complete. It looks easy at first until they learn they have to do it blindfolded.
Jen amazes Small with her tap-dancing skills. Small finds out how ginger is grown and ground. Plus, the two chefs cheer up a lonely gingerbread man with some gingerbread friends.

Hearing dog Diesel is on an important mission, to wake his teenage owner Rayane, who's deaf, up in time for his football trial. There's a big match tomorrow, and Rayane really wants to be picked for the team. It's the summer holidays, so Rayane and Diesel have been sleeping in. Diesel needs to be on high alert! Diesel's superears are trained to alert Rayane to important sounds he might miss. Diesel is Rayane's ears.
Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet some elands and colobus monkeys.
Explore the things that people might carry in their bags and why. Meet people from different backgrounds and jobs to find out more about them.
The After School Club hosts its first talent show, but when the key to a snack treasure chest goes missing, Waffle steps up to save the day.
Oona and Baba get stuck on the cliff during a storm.

Twinkle discovers an army of marching ants taking seeds from her vegetable garden. When all attempts to stop them fail, she and Yukee try to find a way to get the ants marching to a different beat and away from her garden.
Lu, Gus, Declan, Biba, Barnaby, and Elodie have fun at the playground on a dry day, but Elodie ends up leaving Lu feeling sad when she forgets her promise to push her on the swing.
The Piggies wonder what's more fun: playing outside or a board game. So, Charlie builds a giant outdoor board game, but their competitiveness ruins the fun!
When there is nothing there to count and none is the amount, nobody does it better than Zero. Learn about the number zero.

With a dressing up box it must be showtime! B, O and X discover a dressing up box that is filled with everything they need to put on a performance of Sleeping Beauty, except for something to sleep on.
Justin and George meet a friend for gymnastics, and Mr Tumble attempts a very big jump.
Dipsy and Laa-Laa drive to the Hidey Hup in the Tubby Car. They meet Tinky Winky and Po and the Teletubbies go on the Tubby Uppy Downy together.

Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how seaweed plays such an important role in the environment. They find out that seaweed can be a shelter for lots of sea creatures, a great place for seabirds to look for food to eat, and that seaweed helps provide some of the oxygen we breathe. On the way, they see what they can spot in a rock pool and have a picnic of some snacks made from seaweed!
Maddie is looking at useful lights. She finds out how traffic lights work, making sure that vehicles can safely travel through a road junction.
Motorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing machines that are pedal powered. Grace drives a pedal car, shows off a pedal glider and then has a race with Speedy on a water bike.

Mrs Farrell and Miss Gerrard have Kindness Day, so the class show how they can be extra kind. Jessica and Orla draw lovely pictures for the teachers, and Sam helps Solomon with his yoghurt at lunchtime.
When a gigantic saltwater crocodile wanders into freezing waters, the Octonauts must figure out how to get the predator back to his warm water home - without anyone getting hurt.
When Benjamin takes charge of a strawberry harvest raid on Mr McGregor's garden, he learns that it's harder than he thought to be a good leader.

Norrie is having fun looking at nature in the garden. When Roly wants to join in, she tells him he needs to be really quiet, but he gets overexcited, shouting so loudly that he scares a lovely butterfly away. Norrie is put out because Roly did the opposite of what she said. When Roly asks what an opposite is, Norrie struggles to explain. Luckily, Duggee has his Opposites Badge and helps the squirrels understand by using lots of fun examples.
The Piris find a skeleton buried in the ice and think it's an ancient ancestor. But after a series of strange discoveries, things take an unexpected turn.
Supertato, Carrot, Broccoli and Chilli are playing when, suddenly, they hear a scream and discover an upset Evil Pea in her freezer. They soon find out that her throne has been stolen.
The farmer calls the FBI to investigate the weird happenings on the farm. As he shows the agents all the chaos, the Weasy Family watch and remember all of their craziest adventures.
Mojo's got the perfect top for digging up the bones of a Swoppitus Rex. But could an actual dinosaur still be alive under Jackson's field, or is it a case of mistaken identity?
Spark isn't feeling well, but Madam Dragon insists he is fine - just over-excited about his lesson. Zog's intuition tells him Madam Dragon is wrong, but can he tell her?
Dr Ollie forgets who he asked to play the wizard in his play! Ava's memory-jogging machine helps him recall, but things get confusing at the nursery.
Waffle has so much fun on a doggy play date at Mr Willow's house that he decides to stay for a sleepover! The Brooklyn-Bells miss Waffle and can't wait for his return.
Rafi's superhero wish teaches her that teamwork is the greatest power of all.

JoJo is having a sleepover at Gran Gran's house and wonders why the moon is a funny shape. Gran Gran explains to JoJo why the moon appears to change shape in the night sky, and together they make a moon diary for JoJo to take home to Mummy and Daddy.
Nick creates a Podcast Song about a brave penguin called Ruby who was born with one wing.
Major Clanger, Mother, Granny and the Soup Dragon go on a trip to the stars leaving the Iron Chicken in charge of their children. What could possibly go wrong?
MeMo and BaBa realise that spreading a little happiness can make them happy too.

After waking Upsy Daisy, Igglepiggle goes with her for a walk in the garden. Upsy Daisy's bed decides to follow them even when they ride on the Ninky Nonk. When Upsy Daisy decides she would like a rest, her bed makes her chase after it.
Get ready for a magical bedtime with Jonathan Bailey.
Four strangers work as a team to answer general knowledge questions. They must defeat the Chaser, a ruthless quiz genius, in order to win money.
Bradley Walsh hosts as Craig, Michaela, Harry and Frances take on the challenge of the chase and try to beat one of the country's finest quiz brains.
Bradley Walsh welcomes television presenter and novelist Fern Britton, cricketer Matthew Hoggard, entrepreneur Michelle Mone, and actor Neil Morrissey as they take on the Chaser.
The public bring in more items for the dealers to bid on. Today, there are two 1930s suitcases, a magic lantern, a condiment holder, a tin-plate toy and a fairground car-cum table.
Two of the three Goodies, Tim Brooke-Taylor and Graeme Garden, get back into character to take an antiques road trip around Devon.
Contestants compete against each other in a fun-filled competition that tests their dart skills and their general knowledge in a bid to win the valuable prizes.
Bradley Walsh presents the big money quiz based on his own idea which features six players who cannot leave the contest until somebody wins.
A team of four friends and family, Frankie, James, Susanne and Jason, take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they must cross the Bridge, stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies.

Contestants compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.

Patrick Baladi, Vicky Williamson, John Craven, and Kevin Eldon put their knowledge to the test as they attempt to beat the Chaser and win money for charity.
Bradley Walsh hosts as Aaron, Anne, Susan and Joe come together in the hope that as a team they can take on the Chaser and leave with thousands of pounds.
Four strangers work as a team to answer general knowledge questions. They must defeat the Chaser, a ruthless quiz genius, in order to win money.
Colin Jackson, Anne Diamond, Josie Long and Nicky Campbell take on all five of the Chasers who have donned their glad rags for the festive show.
Dartboard quiz game that tests contestants' darts skills and general knowledge.

When the Cheers gang take on a rival bar in a war of outrageous pranks, they soon become paranoid of all strangers entering the bar, including Boston Red Sox's third baseman Wade Boggs.
The competition between Sam "the king" and Woody "the pretender" for who can kiss Rebecca before midnight is intense. However, it seems that Rebecca might have figured out what's going on.
Carrie and Doug reminisce about how they first met, remembering that it certainly wasn't love at first sight.
Doug and Carrie are happy with their new friends. Then the Shmenkmans meet Deacon and Kelly, and it turns out the two couples have a lot more in common. Is friend theft in the air?
Doug takes Arthur out for lunch, so Carrie can arrange a surprise birthday party. Doug runs into some problems with Arthur, while the waiting guests back home start to fight.
After an accidental tip-off from Ray which allows him to win a bet, Frank makes everyone suspicious when he begins to show an unusual interest in Ray's work.
Ray and Debra try to decide who should care for their children in case anything should happen to them.
Debra's hippie sister, Jennifer, visits Ray and Debra's home and announces she has decided to become a nun.

A scheming Frasier finally works his way into hosting the annual televised Christmas parade but is horrified to learn that his wildly successful protégé - the sassy, brassy radio host Dr Mary - will be his co-host, prompting a battle royal for control of the microphone.
Frasier confers with a mentor after falling victim to a midlife crisis, and Daphne is hungry all the time.
Three generations of Cranes clash in the great outdoors when Frasier's 13-year-old son (Trevor Einhorn) visits.
Frasier and Niles realise their helplessness when Frasier's car stalls, so they enrol in a car repair night class. They quickly fall behind, and understand what it's like to be remedial students.
Gordon must revamp Lowery's Seafood, where his crew finds two brothers at odds and a dedicated team confused about where to look for leadership.

In Cornwall, Anouska and Greig transform a basement storeroom into a guest bedroom. In Humberside, Lucy and Seb make big strides to see if their sweeping staircase can be saved. And in Shropshire, Alan and Catherine cook up an al fresco living space.

Sarah hosts a teen talent show in her dining room. Designer Richard unveils a property to clients who've paid two million dollars but haven't seen it yet. Sean juggles work and his wedding anniversary. And Nick hosts his long-distance family.
Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host, with Konnie Huq in Dictionary Corner, as contestants race against the clock to pit their wits against vowels, consonants and numbers.

Danni Menzies house-hunts with Anne and Gordon from Northumberland, who met each other four years ago and now dream of buying a holiday home together in Kefalonia. With a budget of £200,000, Danni hopes to find them their perfect property.

Kevin and Anna's ancient French estate finds itself in the eye of a storm. As wedding bells ring at one of Carl and Francesca's villages, disaster strikes at the other when one of its oldest buildings collapses.
Payment day brings with it frank discussions about everything from questionable hosting skills to substandard breakfasts, before the BandBers learn how much they've been paid and who's won.

Clinical practitioner Laura hosts the final night in north Wales, with a 'day at the races' theme. As Laura makes it to the finishing line, has she done enough to take first place and bag the £1000 prize? Or will it be a one-horse race?

Carol and Russell look for a forever home in rural Coín in southern Spain. Jasmine Harman shows them five options for their maximum budget of £350k. A solar-powered stunner leaves them speechless, and a turnkey treat gives them food for thought.
Channel 4's flagship news programme. With sport and weather.

In China, an obesity crisis and the cultural pressure to be thin are pushing young people towards extreme ways to lose weight. Ciaran Jenkins travels to Chengdu to explore China's often contradictory food and body culture.
In Radcliffe-on-Trent, Joel and Nicola restore Joel's grandparents' 1970s Victorian cottage to its full former glory and add a plush extension, with a stretched budget and a tight Yuletide timeline.

Offering their unmatched satirical insight into current world events, Adam Hills, Alex Brooker and a special co-host are joined by Lucy Beaumont, Nish Kumar and Luisa Omielan to help dissect the biggest news stories of the week.
Sarah Millican returns to the stage with her show covering topics such as road rage, IBS, her favourite word and how she lets her husband know that "tonight's the night".

Karl reminisces about an overabundance of breath mints throughout his childhood. After years of nursing a childhood leg injury, Karl visits a massage therapist with dubious credentials. Ricky, Stephen and Karl describe their earliest memories and later, Karl finds an adult magazine in his doctor's waiting room and learns about alternative lifestyles.

After contemplating the concept of memory, Ricky and Karl perform a role play where they are the two lobes of Karl's brain. The girls speculate as to who's the father of Rachel's baby, the guys scramble after Chandler loses the film from his wedding, and Monica wants to open the wedding gifts.
Everybody seems to know who the father of Rachel's baby is except the man himself. Meanwhile, Phoebe and Joey lie about a gas leak to get into Monica and Chandler's apartment.
Ross gets upset when Rachel goes out on a date with a handsome actor, Phoebe tries to prevent a chef from being sacked, and Chandler kills a co-worker's promotion.
At Monica's Halloween party, Phoebe meets the friendly fiancé of her flighty twin Ursula, but becomes alarmed when she learns that her sister has misrepresented herself to her trusting future in-law.

Joey is thrilled when his name is used in a 'Soap Opera Digest' crossword puzzle. He is reluctant to let the magazine do a profile of him, but Rachel tries to persuade him to reconsider so that he can mention her.

Monica and Phoebe host Rachel's baby shower but forget to invite her mother. Rachel realises she is clueless about caring for the baby after birth. Meanwhile, Joey auditions to host a new game show called 'Bamboozled'.

When Monica's cooking at the restaurant receives a harsh write-up in a newspaper, she goes to a criticism class taught by the reviewer, hoping to convince him to reconsider his opinion. Meanwhile, Rachel gets upset when a cute salesgirl flirts with Ross while he and Rachel are shopping for baby supplies, and nervous about a major job interview, Chandler receives some questionable coaching from Phoebe.
Eight days overdue, Rachel grows irritable, prompting a bet between Monica and Phoebe. Meanwhile, Joey invites Chandler to his new film's screening.
Rachel waits in the hospital maternity ward with an anxious Ross. To her dismay, she is put in a semi-private room. Then, the heavily pregnant Janice is assigned to share the room with her.
Rachel doubts Ross's commitment to her and the baby. Meanwhile, Ross wants to confess his love for Rachel. Joey discovers Ross's mother's engagement ring on the floor.

Due to a misunderstanding, Rachel finds herself engaged to Joey instead of Ross shortly after giving birth to her and Ross's baby girl. Meanwhile, Joey can't help taking a look as Rachel tries unsuccessfully to nurse her baby. Inspired to have a baby of their own, Monica and Chandler retire to a hospital cupboard for a little privacy.

Joey's futile attempts to gain Ross's forgiveness for mistakenly asking Rachel to marry him only result in emergency hospitalisation. Meanwhile, an exhausted Rachel desperately searches for a solution to end baby Emma's non-stop crying.

Rachel's constant calls to Emma's paediatrician force him to reject her as a patient. Meanwhile, Chandler plans to move to Tulsa for work, but worries about whether career-minded Monica is still willing to join him, and Joey and Phoebe agree to find each other companions for a double date.

Phoebe fears losing her latest prospective boyfriend Mike and her self-doubt is not helped by Ross' careless comments. Meanwhile, Chandler is in Tulsa on a work assignment, and when Monica surprises him in his hotel room, she mistakenly thinks that he has a sexual fetish for sharks.

While Phoebe and Joey wait at a fancy restaurant for their friends' arrival to celebrate Phoebe's birthday, Rachel is delayed because she is afraid to leave Emma with a babysitter. Monica and Chandler also fail to arrive on time after having a row about Chandler's urge to resume smoking and then giving in to other urges.
Ross mocks Rachel's new male nanny, and Chandler becomes upset when Monica says that somebody from her job is the funniest guy she's ever met.

When Chandler's former romantic rival intends to sell his flat, insecure Chandler persuades Joey to help him secretly inspect it and the guys are shocked to discover an old videotape featuring Monica having sex with Richard.

On the night before Thanksgiving, Rachel's self-centred younger sister Amy ruins everyone's holiday dinner with her uncensored observations. Meanwhile, Monica obsessively protects her good wedding china, and Joey forgets to join his television cast mates in the big Thanksgiving parade.

Rachel impulsively gives a handsome restaurant patron her telephone number, and worries that he'll call when Ross is in their apartment. Meanwhile, Phoebe's boyfriend Mike and Ross desperately try to find something in common to talk about when they babysit Emma, and Chandler returns from Tulsa to visit Monica, but must hide from Joey after rejecting his offer of free basketball tickets.

Chandler is forced to remain in Tulsa over the Christmas period due to a major deadline at work, and Monica fears the worst when she finds out that he will be joined in Tulsa by a beautiful colleague Wendy. While he works, Chandler recalls some of the more embarrassing moments from previous holidays shared with his friends.

More everyday items are put under the microscope as we discover how car tyres, silk, art conservation and scuba tanks are made.
More everyday items are put under the microscope as we discover how rock crushers, fabric lampshades, cake sprinkles and steam irons are made.

Clayton Phipps and his team prepare to flip a 20,000-pound carnivore fossil out of the earth and onto a flatbed to get it to the lab for analysis. Meanwhile, Mike Harris hunts for a duckbill skull and Jared Hudson uncovers an ancient reptile.

Clayton must haul his 20,000-pound dinosaur fossil over 200 miles to a lab where it will finally be identified. The Harris/Bolan clan chases poachers off of their land and Jared makes a last-ditch effort to bring in some money this season.
Following Aron's successful test of his Death Ray, Jack shifts his focus to Nikola Tesla's potential murder. The first suspect sends Jack and Cameron overseas to Serbia to look for clues.
Rob examines bizarre markings that suggest a violent clash between prehistoric beasts. In California, he explores a bizarre lake for alien life.
How do they turn trees into toilet paper? How do they make authentic absinthe, and how do they make cricket balls tough enough to face test match batsmen?
Discover how they make the world's strongest knives, grow diamonds in the laboratory, and produce enough bricks to build the modern world.

Derek and his brother Sean head back to their family farm in North Dakota. Intent on building a goin'-to-town rig for the old farmstead, they dig out a 1971 Chevrolet Chevelle saloon that's buried in cow pies and has a waterlogged engine.
Drew spots a 1960s Mini that may be for sale, although he is wondering if he can buy it for a good price. A Cotswold dealer has a Porsche 928, but the budget is hit by some major repairs.
Ant finds a rare 1978 TVR Taimar in an Oxfordshire Garden. Despite oil leaks, dodgy paint and a missing heater box, he's hooked.

Henry and Sam are up in Lancashire. Today they are with Miles, a petrol head whose sheds contain an amazing collection of vintage bikes and rare British and American four-wheelers. But what will he part with?
Henry and Sam are exploring an Aladdin's cave of different sheds all on one property, and they are over the moon with their finds - a vintage bike and a stationary engine, all for under £50!
Richard Hammond goes behind the scenes of Tottenham Hotspur's new groundbreaking football stadium in London, as he explores a pitch that splits and rolls away and takes a terrifying walk on the roof.
Andy squeezes a Hemi engine into a Jeep Wrangler for a power boost. Meanwhile, Jeff revives an '86 RX-7 with a Corvette LT1 motor, and Tim rehabs a trashed Boston Whaler.

Tragedy strikes a bustling Canadian shopping mall when a parking garage suddenly collapses resulting in a fatal disaster; expert engineers use the latest technology to investigate and uncover a deadly design flaw that could have been prevented.

Disaster strikes a new railway bridge as a crane collapses in the middle of major construction in Italy; experts investigate and uncover a compromise in balance with improperly positioned counterweights and a manoeuvre that resulted in catastrophe.

Mike and Elvis head to sun-drenched Portugal where the iconic, beach-friendly Mini Moke has earned cult status. It's a car with a very special place in Mike's heart. But severe water damage and chronic rust makes it a total restoration job.
After Edd surprises Mike by purchasing a 1916 Cadillac V8, the guys work relentlessly to get the car ready to take part in an epic 9,000-mile Peking to Paris endurance rally.

Henry and Sam are rummaging about in what can only be described as a tractor enthusiast's heaven. Sheds and fields full of tractors and machinery, some in mint condition and others buried under a mass of weeds, hedges and grass.

Henry and Sam find themselves down in the South West rummaging around another belting shed with all sorts of things on offer. So much so that it is virtually impossible to pick one thing - so they come back with a handful.

Mike and Elvis take a gamble as they head to Germany and buy a neglected Audi RS2 that they can't test drive. This highly collectable estate car could earn them a bumper profit, but it could also turn into a €40k money pit.

Jonny Lieberman and Jethro Bovingdon pit two big-name vehicles against each other on the ultimate road trip in Germany and Austria. From autobahns with no speed limit to the wild Nürburgring race circuit, and a mountain pass that climbs to a glacier.
Jethro Bovingdon and Jonny Lieberman head to Spain to explore two of the grand touring cars, the new Aston DB11 and the big Lexus LC.
A crane disastrously falls across two lanes of traffic during construction work on a landmark bridge in New York City.
Steve and Sam get into deep trouble transporting a state-of-the-art Navy mine sweeper. Plus, Simon has his hands full shifting a monstrous rock-crusher to Kent.

Mum geht zu einer Babyparty. Somit muss Dad das abendliche Programm vor dem Zubettgehen übernehmen. Jedoch vermisst Bluey schnell ihre Mum und ist traurig. Daraufhin lässt Dad sich jede Menge Spiele einfallen, um Bluey abzulenken.
Das Spidey-Team sucht im Meer nach einem Seeungeheuer. / Kobold-Glibber verschmutzt den Fluss.
Amber fühlt sich ausgeschlossen. Layla freundet sich mit Amber an.

Chiffen ist ganz aufgeregt, als er im Zauberwald ein geheimnisvolles Ei findet. Wem gehört es nur? Darly und Loomis helfen ihm, es zu seiner Mutter zurückzubringen, doch der Abschied fällt Chiffen schwer.
Dracoon nimmt sein Lieblingsspielzeug mit auf ein Abenteuer.

Als Haleys Vorgesetzter nach einem erfolgversprechenden Rezept für ein Produkt aus Chilischoten sucht, wittert Haley ihre Chance. Sie versucht, Gloria vom Verkauf ihres Salsa-Dips zu überzeugen. Derweil hat Mitch eine Überraschung für Cam.

Als Dede unerwartet zu Besuch kommt, sprechen Mitch und Cam über die Rolle, die Mutter Pritchett in ihrem Leben spielt. Unterdessen warten Phil, Luke, Haley und Alex auf den richtigen Moment, um Claire schlechte Nachrichten zu überbringen.

Trotz Gregs Belehrungen verliert Dharma einen teuren Ring, den ihr Kitty zur Hochzeit geschenkt hatte. Nach langem Suchen kann sie den verdreckten Ring doch noch finden und bringt ihn zu einem Juwelier. Dort erlebt sie eine Überraschung.
Larry bekommt die Gelegenheit einen Buchladen, den er sehr mag, zu kaufen. Greg will beweisen, dass UFOs nicht existieren.
Dharma bietet Gregs früherer Sekretärin ihre Hilfe an, da sie große Probleme bei der Suche eines Jobs hat.

Schmidt, Coach und Winston freuen sich über die neuen attraktiven Nachbarinnen Michelle und Laurie. Aber natürlich versauen die drei gleich das erste Aufeinandertreffen total. Sie wollen es beim nächsten Mal besser machen.

Am Morgen nach ihrer Trennung versuchen Jess und Nick, dies vor ihren Mitbewohnern geheim zu halten. Winston schafft die Aufnahmeprüfung für die Polizeiakademie und erwartet von seinen Freunden eine besondere Belohnung.

Mrs. Münzberg hat zu einem Ball in der Villa geladen und fürchtet, dass ihre Tanzkünste nicht ausreichen. Binikos bemüht sich, aus Mrs. Münzberg eine bessere Tänzerin zu machen. Doch alle seine Bemühungen haben keinen Erfolg.

Als Kätzchen Taffy verkleidet, will sich der immer hungrige Waschbär Zecki Zugang zu Mrs. Münzbergs teurer Villa und damit ihrem gut gefüllten Kühlschrank verschaffen. Aber er rechnet dabei nicht mit Mrs. Münzbergs scharfsinnigem Hund Bentley.

Um als Oberhaupt des Münzberg-Clans die Verantwortung für das enorme Familienvermögen zu übernehmen, muss Mrs. Münzberg beweisen, dass sie bereit ist. Als sie eine Puppe aus ihrer Kindheit findet, benimmt sie sich wieder wie ein Kind.

Benedikt soll diesmal einen echten T-Rex streicheln. Aber abgesehen davon, dass so ein fleischfressender Tyrannosaurus nicht gerade ein Kuscheltier ist, sind die Dinosaurier doch schon vor einigen Millionen Jahren ausgestorben.

In der Schule stellen die Eltern ihre Berufe vor. Als Chloés Armreif aus ihrer Tasche verschwindet, versucht Sabrinas Vater Roger, ein Polizist, zu helfen. Doch als Monsieur Bourgeois ihn feuert, nutzt Hawk Moth Rogers Verbitterung aus.
Cat Noir und Ladybug müssen Kim retten, der am Valentinstag in Dark Cupid verwandelt wurde.

Die eigentlich unzertrennliche Freundschaft zwischen Liff und Barry wird durch ein Geschenk auf eine harte Probe gestellt. Darüber hinaus verirrt sich Liff mit der gesamten Clique im Wald und erlebt mit ihnen eine schreckliche Begegnung.

Cricket und seine Familie ziehen vom Land in die Großstadt, was zuerst einen großen Kulturschock auslöst. Doch Cricket ist optimistisch und naiv, was ihn schnell neue Freunde finden lässt. Zusammen erleben sie viele Abenteuer in der großen Stadt.
Auf der Suche nach Informationen über ihr Lieblingseis verliert sich Tilly im Internet.
Der Herrscher der Londoner Tiere ist besorgt über eine Reihe von Katzenentführungen.

Nicki, Experiment 276, wird aktiviert: Es schleicht sich in Träume ein und verwandelt sie in Alpträume. Lilo ist deprimiert und legt sich hin, um den ganzen Tag zu schlafen. Natürlich schleicht sich sofort Experiment 276 in ihr Ohr und verbreitet in ihren Träumen Angst und Schrecken. Um das gefährliche Experiment einzufangen, transportiert sich Jumba mit Pleakley und Stitch in Lilos Traum.

Carl bittet Monty, ihm dabei zu helfen, dass sich Major Monogram endlich einmal bei ihm bedankt. Unterdessen glaubt Candace, endlich einen Weg gefunden zu haben, die Abenteuer ihrer Brüder auffliegen zu lassen. Als Phineas und Ferb herausfinden, dass Candace für ihren Buchclub die "Ilias" lesen muss, stellen sie kurzerhand die legendäre Belagerung von Troja nach. Unterdessen hilft Perry versehentlich Dr. Doofenschmirtz dabei, seine Wohnung zu entrümpeln.

Bingo ist völlig davon überzeugt, dass der Osterhase sie wie im vergangenen Jahr vergessen hat. Bluey findet daraufhin allerdings eine Reihe von Hinweisen, die sie auf eine großartige Schatzsuche mit zahlreichen Ostereiern führen.
Animated, Children, Holiday, Entertainment, Adventure, Animals
Bluey freut sich auf ihr eigenes Zimmer. Doch als Schlafenszeit ist, vermisst sie Bingo.

Als Mama einen Hindernisparcours im Garten lediglich zum Spaß an der Sache einrichtet, will Papa ein Rennen veranstalten. Dementsprechend haben die Kinder nun Mut geschlossen, um mit allen Mitteln als Gewinner herauszugehen.

Bluey lernt von Bingo, wie wichtig es ist, ein Versprechen einzuhalten, das man gibt. Sie bricht immer wieder ihre Versprechen, doch als sie Bingo dabei zusieht, wie sehr er sich auf die Worte von Mama verlassen kann, ändert sich ihre Meinung.
Bingo hilft seiner Mutter dabei, ein Omelett für Papas Geburtstagsfrühstück zu machen.

Die Schüler Marinette und Adrien erhalten die Fähigkeit, sich in die Superhelden Ladybug und Cat Noir zu verwandeln und können dadurch das Glück und das Pech manipulieren. Sie wollen dem Bösewicht Hawk Moth das Handwerk legen.

Zusammen mit Äffchen Abu macht der Straßenjunge Aladdin die Gassen der Basare unsicher. Aber er träumt von einem besseren Leben. Vor allem seit er Jasmin, die Tochter des Sultans, kennengelernt hat. Plötzlich ändert sich Aladdins Leben schlagartig, denn er gelangt in den Besitz einer Wunderlampe, die es wirklich in sich hat: Sie beherbergt einen gigantischen, unendlich ausgeflippten Flaschengeist namens Dschinni, der seinem Besitzer drei Wünsche erfüllen kann.
Movie, Animated, Children, Musical comedy, Adventure, Fantasy

Tief unten in der Stille des Ozeans lebt Arielle, die Meerjungfrau. Sie ist die Tochter von Triton, dem Unterwasserkönig, aber anstatt ihren höfischen Pflichten nachzukommen, geht sie lieber zusammen mit dem kleinen Fisch Fabius auf Entdeckungsreise an die Oberfläche und sammelt Schätze von den Menschen. Arielle wünscht sich nämlich heimlich, selbst ein Mensch zu sein. Bei einem Unwetter rettet Arielle Prinz Eric das Leben und von da an ist es dann um sie geschehen.

Olaf erzählt die Geschichte von "Arielle, die Meerjungfrau" in seiner eigenen Interpretation. Dabei nimmt er die Figurenrollen von Arielle, Triton, Scuttle und auch dem Koch Louis ein sowie der bösen Meerhexe Ursula in bester Olaf-Manier.

Percy erhält den Auftrag, den Herrscherblitz von Zeus zurückzubringen. Dieser Auftrag ist äußerst wichtig, um einen Krieg zwischen den Göttern zu verhindern. Infolgedessen möchte er von Annabeth und Grover in die Unterwelt begleitet werden.

Die Jagd auf die Helden wird intensiver, als Percy, Annabeth und Grover von Mächten gejagt werden, die schlimmer sind, als sie angenommen haben. Sie verletzen sich und suchen Zuflucht im St. Louis Arch, wo sie überlegen, ob sie um Hilfe rufen sollen.

Jess und Cece werden per Zufall zu einer Party des legendären Musikstars Prince eingeladen. Da Nick, Schmidt, Winston und Coach sich diesen Spaß nicht entgehen lassen wollen, versuchen sie, sich irgendwie in Prince' Partyvilla einzuschleusen.

Nick trifft zufällig auf seine Ex-Freundin Caroline, was ihn in eine unangenehme Situation bringt. Jess will Nick davon überzeugen, dass er und Caroline trotz allem Freunde sein können und stellt ihm deshalb ihren Ex-Freund Berkeley vor.
Als Jess' wilde Schwester Abby zu Besuch kommt, wird die ganze WG ins Chaos gestürzt. Derweil bittet Schmidt Nick, ihn zu einer Bar Mizwa zu begleiten, um ihm dabei zu helfen, eine Frau aufzureißen.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Am Wochenende ist Museumstag im Carshop. Max Cornelius erwartet Besucher aus Norddeutschland, denen er seine Auto- und Mopedsammlung präsentieren möchte. Doch bevor er in Friesland die Tore öffnet, will er noch ein besonderes Exponat aufhübschen.

Sergeant Scott Dupre patrouilliert das St. Mary Parish, um Wilderern das Handwerk zu legen. Daraufhin kommt er einem verletzten Adler zu Hilfe. Außerdem wurde ein Hirsch illegal geschossen und über die Grenze des Bundesstaates gebracht.

Zwei Wildhüter werden von einem Landbesitzer wegen eines Problems mit einem Jäger gerufen. Dieser soll von der Straße aus einen Hirsch geschossen haben, doch das Jagen und Schießen in bewohntem Gebiet oder im Bereich von Verkehrswegen ist verboten.

Als ein verdächtiger Jäger bei einer Lüge ertappt wird, beauftragt Wildhüter Preston Whisenhunt einen K-9-Tracker, um die Beweise zu erschnüffeln. Außerdem verstecken zwei Männer, die illegal in einem Flussbett parken, etwas.

Jennifer Provaznik und ihr Partner Austin Shoemaker patrouillieren am Texas-City-Damm. Die Wildhüter kontrollieren dort Angelscheine und sichern den Fortbestand der Artenvielfalt. Todd Long bekommt es unterdessen mit einem Missetäter zu tun.

Durch steigende Wassertemperaturen sinken die Quoten der Krabbenfischer in der Beringsee. Die Unternehmer stehen vor großen Herausforderungen. Denn der Unterhalt einer Flotte ist kostspielig und dies bedroht die Existenz vieler Fischer.

Über der Beringsee braut sich ein Unwetter zusammen. Jetzt müssen die Kapitäne der Krabbenfangflotte entscheiden, ob sie den arktischen Wintersturm im Hafen abwarten oder ob sie den gefährlichen Bedingungen zum Trotz aufs Meer hinausfahren.

Kapitän Monte Colburn zieht die letzten prall gefüllten Körbe an Deck. Für die Mannschaft geht eine ertragreiche Opilio-Saison zu Ende. Aber kaum im Hafen von Dutch Harbor angekommen, liefern sich die Brüder Colburn einen heftigen Streit.

Ein erfahrener Prüfer nimmt in Arizona die "Albatross" in Sachen Flugtauglichkeit unter die Lupe. Es stellt sich die Frage, ob die Korrosion an den Tragflächen der 60 Jahre alten Maschine eine Gefahr darstellt oder nicht.

Michael erhält Besuch aus Polen von Marian. Er bringt zwei restaurierte Mutts zum Verkauf mit. Bei der Prüfung der Fahrzeuge werden jedoch Mängel entdeckt und eines davon ist bereits verkauft. Es kommt zu einer Konfrontation auf dem Firmenhof.

Ein 40 Tonnen schwerer Kran soll von Sevilla aus nach Deutschland transportiert werden. Doch es gibt schon Probleme bei der Anreise. Damit der Kran über Straßen rollen darf, müssen zuvor Teile mit dem Schneidbrenner entfernt werden.

Selfmade-Millionär Klaus möchte seinen imposanten Fuhrpark um ein Hummer Cabriolet erweitern. Da ist er bei Michael Manousakis genau an der richtigen Adresse. Auf dem Gelände von 'Morlock Motors' in Peterslahr warten Hunderte ausrangierte Fahrzeuge der amerikanischen Streitkräfte auf einen neuen Besitzer, denn die 'Steel Buddys' haben einen exklusiven Vertrag mit der United States Army. Und bei der Suche nach einem geeigneten Modell läuft das Team zu Höchstform auf.

In dieser Episode müssen die Steel Buddys ihr Schraubertalent unter Beweis stellen. Ertems mobile Burger-Bude bewegt sich keinen Zentimeter vom Fleck. Jeder Tag, an dem der elf Meter lange Airstream streikt, kostet seinen Besitzer 1000 Euro. Um den Chevrolet Pick-up von Johannes ist es noch schlimmer bestellt. Im Grunde ist der Wagen Schrott. Doch Michael Manousakis und seine Truppe nehmen die Herausforderung an und kümmern sich um die zwei Problemfälle.

Daniel Abbott senkt die Stützen seines Bergungstrucks ab, um das Fahrzeug zu stabilisieren. Dann bringt er den Ausleger in Position. Der Schwerlastprofi soll einen Hubsteiger bergen, der in Herefordshire von einem Feldweg abgekommen ist.

Die Sendung informiert über alle wichtigen Neuigkeiten aus der Welt. Die Zuschauer bekommen so einen Überblick über den aktuellen Stand verschiedenster Themen wie Gesellschaft, Kultur, Politik, Sport, Wirtschaft und Zeitgeschehen.

Wegen extremer Kälte und Eis rutscht ein Lkw auf der Zufahrt zu einem Bauernhof in Northumbria ab. Kevin Whitelaw und Ian starten eine Bergungsaktion mit einem Spezialfahrzeug. Parallel kämpft Bohdan Tkaczyk mit einer widerspenstigen Steckachse.

Shane und Lacey streiten sich heftig, doch um in der Wildnis Südafrikas zu überleben, müssen sie zusammenhalten. An einem Wassertümpel versucht die Gruppe, Fische zu fangen, doch das stellt sich als ziemlich schwierig heraus.
Shawn needs a strong start to build his mega-dredge but newcomer Ken and the 600-ton Myrtle Irene may have beat him to it. Emily's plan to dive deep is in jeopardy.
To fund the mega-dredge, Shawn races to the Bluff where Kris is onto some of the best gold. Emily's most promising summer might suddenly be dashed on the rocks.
Jacqui and Andrew face a night-time detecting mission for lost gold.
A man surprises his wife for their wedding anniversary. He secretly builds a holiday home with an L-shaped eco-shell to blend into the surroundings.

Naturalist builder Cat Taylor builds a remote sanctuary in the piney woods of Northwest Texas; she builds the two-story house using a cob mixture and adds touches of comfort to entertain family members.
The Cornelia Marie must come to terms with their ailing Captain, all the while suffering from a deluge of jellyfish out to sting them all.

Josh Gates travels to Hungary to join three separate archaeological teams looking for the lost tomb of Attila the Hun. Legends and ancient texts lead the search from the bottom of the Danube to the mountain forests just outside of Budapest.

On the Mediterranean island of Crete, the Minoans built one of the most glorious civilisations in the ancient world and then mysteriously vanished. Josh travels to Greece to find out how Europe's first superpower disappeared.

In a race against the coming snow, the Raneys push beyond their limits to finish two cabins, harvest the garden and mount a hunting expedition. When a risky project results in a devastating injury, the family is in danger of losing it all.

As Marty recovers from a bad fall, the Raneys scramble against the oncoming winter to finish cabin walls and build a staircase from an ancient family spruce. Matt leads a last-ditch moose hunt pivotal to keeping them stocked with meat through spring.
Oscar sends The Cheals on an important mission to unearth a rare green-orange gemstone for a potential buyer. The Mooka Boys get a motor problem.
The Bushmen dig a passage to a new emergency shaft. The Mooka Boys use a crane to lift a homemade shelter over the Lunatic Opal Field.
The Victoria Diggers are back on the hunt for multi-million-dollar nuggets. Plus, rookie team the Dust Devils run into big trouble with a new dry blower.
The Poseidon Crew face a devastating financial disaster after permit delays. Plus, the Victoria Diggers are still awaiting approval to dig German Gully.

A Corvette disappears into a hole in the ground in the US state of Kentucky. In Australia, a disaster occurs during the construction of a huge bridge in the centre of Melbourne. Heavy construction work shakes the earth in Oklahoma.

In May 2024, dozens of eyewitnesses captured rare twin tornadoes as they carved a parallel path of destruction across Iowa. With winds near 300 mph, the twister sisters toppled farms, shredded wind turbines and devastated the town of Greenfield.
Phil tracks what could be an unknown species, while Jess hunts for evidence that a legendary creature is nearby.

Nach einem Unfall mit seinem Laster steht der Eiergroßhändler Zackel vor dem Bankrott. Dann glaubt er jedoch, auf dem Grundstück der attraktiven Witwe Mia Schöner ein Uranvorkommen entdeckt zu haben, das er sich zusammen mit seinen alten Freunden Kleiner und Itzenblitz sichern will. Zu diesem Zweck planen die drei, die schöne Witwe und ihre beiden Töchter zu umgarnen und am besten gleich zu heiraten. Bei der Brautwerbung kommt es jedoch zu allerlei Missverständnissen.

Neueste Produkte werden im Fernsehen für ein bequemes Einkaufserlebnis präsentiert. Von praktischen Haushaltshelfern und weichen Badetüchern bis hin zu vielseitigen Sportgeräten bietet das abwechslungsreiche Sortiment zahlreiche Angebote.

Ob Sonne, Regen, Sturm oder Schnee - bei uns sind Sie immer aktuell informiert. Sehen Sie mehrmals tagsüber im Programm den Wetterbericht mit der Vorhersage für ganz Deutschland. Kompakt, schnell und verlässlich!

Michael Niekammer trifft die Schlagersängerin Daniela Alfinito bei einem Videodreh in Slowenien. Im persönlichen Gespräch gewährt die Künstlerin private Einblicke, spricht über die große Liebe und ihr neues Album und präsentiert bekannte Hits.

Edward Collins will nichts weiter, als ein bescheidenes Leben leben. Doch als Millionär mit einer luxuriösen Villa, Chauffeur und allem, was das Herz begehrt, sind die Frauen hinter ihm nur so her. Doch dieses Mal will Edward auf Nummer sicher gehen und heckt zusammen mit seinem ergebenen Butler Alfons einen Plan aus: Der süßen Kellnerin Ninette, die er per Zufall kennenlernt, erzählt Edward, er sei völlig mittellos.

Die hübsche Conny arbeitet im noblen Palace-Hotel ihres Onkels, um das Hotelfach kennenzulernen. Bei einem Fahrradunfall begegnet sie Peter, der als Kellner jobbt. Als Peter von seinem zwielichtigen Chef gefeuert wird, bringt ihn Conny als Assistenten des trotteligen Hoteldetektivs Mägerli im Palace-Hotel unter. Hier gibt es jede Menge zu tun, denn immer dreistere Diebstähle sorgen seit kurzer Zeit für Aufregung. Doch die Diebe haben nicht mit Conny und Peter gerechnet.

Das eingespielte Team Jimmy Bondi und sein gelber Superkäfer Dudu treten bei der Hell's Driver Autoshow in Liverpool auf. Doch nach der Show brennt der dubiöse Veranstalter Ivan Leskovich heimlich mit den Showeinnahmen durch. Jimmy und Dudu, das draufgängerische Team, sind ihm jedoch sofort auf den Fersen. Eine wilde Verfolgungsjagd quer über den halben Erdball beginnt. Trotzdem bleibt noch Zeit für etwas Romantik zwischen zwei Autos.
When a near-death experience leads to several members of the family deciding to make life changes, the rest of the clan bears the brunt of their new attitudes.
All-out war is declared when Claire confronts the next door neighbours about their eyesore of a boat. Plus, Cam takes Lily to clown school.
A short clip from Rude Tube's incredibly naughty little sister Rude-ish Tube, featuring food and animals.
In Bristol, Lee and Nicky serve an Italian menu, but their portions might be too big. A scary doll joins the guests for dinner on Libby and Graham's night. And, Nico and Sky throw a Mexican fiesta.

Gordon heads to Boston for the first of two visits to La Galleria 33, an Italian restaurant opened in 2006 by raucous sisters Rita and Lisa. The two siblings grew up working at their father's successful restaurant nearby, but when they opened their own establishment, the customers didn't materialise. The sisters blame everything from the weather to the tablecloths for their failures.

Gordon confronts restaurant owners and sisters Rita and Lisa with an ultimatum. His stand-off with the siblings is just the beginning of the explosive action. He finds himself stuck in a war between the waiters, chefs and owners over who is to blame for the restaurant's failings. Can Gordon wrangle these hapless proprietors and stubborn employees back into one productive team and save the restaurant?

A dad discovers his toddler has covered himself and the backseat with Nutella; a couple locked out of their house encourages their dog to unlock the door from the inside; parents trick their daughters into thinking they're taking a limo to school.
Will and Carlton spy on Ashley when she goes on her first date with a famous young rap singer named Little T.
Hilary lands a new job as an assistant to actress Marissa Redman, who turns out to be completely disrespectful. Marissa takes a liking to Will.
Everyone enjoys roasting Homer until Kang and Kodos announce that the alien duo are actually judging all of humanity, leaving the fate of the entire world resting on Homer's shoulders.
Inspired by Stan Lee of Marvel Comics, Bart creates an animated series based on his life with a character named 'Angry Dad'.
Lisa befriends college girls who are unaware of her age, and Bart must live in a bubble after being bitten by a Chinese mosquito.
After an old woman placed in Homer's care dies, he is convicted of murder and sentenced to die in the electric chair.
Erica thinks her singing dreams have come true when she lands a job at a new karaoke bar in town. Murray teaches Barry and Lainey financial responsibility.
When Adam tells Beverly he doesn't want her to chaperone the school trip to a theme park, his mother tries to manipulate him with `guilt letters'.
Phil is invited to appear on the local news in a real estate segment and Jay is helping Manny prepare his video interview for college applications.
Halloween parties create hilarious mishaps and confrontations as everyone tries to get through the scary night.
Phil considers becoming a member at Jay's favourite place of refuge. Claire is mistaken about her influence on Alex's choices. Cam refrains from telling Mitchell what his play is really about.
Cameron spares no effort or expense for his Thanksgiving celebration. Hayley tells Phil she would rather spend the holiday with her new boyfriend.

When Mr Burns gives high-tech eyeglasses to his employees to spy on them, Homer loves the enhanced reality of his new gadget until he finds out that Marge is seeing a marriage counsellor after she tries them on.
During a research trip, Lisa learns that Sideshow Bob is the chief scientist at a big chemical engineering company; Marge tries to teach a teen church group about healthy sexual practises.
A recent transfer student named Diggs (Daniel Radcliffe) rescues Bart from a confrontation with bullies.
When Retirement Castle is closed, Marge asks Grampa and two other octogenarians to move in. Meanwhile, Nelson befriends Bart after Bart defends him.

When a huge snowdrift engulfs the school, the kids rebel, gagging Principal Skinner, tying him to a chair and running amok. Meanwhile, Homer and Flanders' rescue operation is going disastrously, and the fate of Skinner and the kids rests in the paws of a lone hamster.

Two teachers head out on a double date, but when they run into familiar bar patrons, it proves to be an unfortunate distraction; at Ava's first book club meeting, the group ends up in a debate over who would be the best post-apocalyptic leader.
Will buys a used car and promptly crashes into a law student's vehicle.
It is party time at the Banks residence, and the neighbour makes a surprise appearance. Then the family silver disappears, and Carlton and Will get on the case.

Jay, Neil, Simon and Will reunite in Australia after the gang finds out that Jay is indulging in a life of hedonism and promiscuity as a star DJ in Sydney. However, when they get there, they discover that Jay has vastly overstated his success.
Natalie dates a swinging golf pro and a man who is old enough to be her grandfather. David dates a woman who is an emotional roller coaster and another who turns from nice to naughty.

The team explores Harlan County's courthouse and jail, seeking evidence of apparitions, eerie voices and other unexplained phenomena. This grim execution site may still harbour echoes of a revenge killing and the region's coal wars.

The team conducts a thorough investigation at White Hall manor, seeking the alleged screaming ghost of legislator Cassius Marcellus Clay. They delve into the life of this uncompromising political figure who is said to haunt the halls.
The team investigates the history of an Old Louisville house where almost every member of the mysterious Brennan family died.

New equipment helps investigators contact familiar spirits at the Conrad-Caldwell House Museum. Fresh data and insights into the Kentucky Anomaly may aid Brandon in uncovering the core of this haunting.
A correctional officer witnesses the Grim Reaper collect the soul of a dead inmate from a prison. Documentary drama about apparent paranormal encounters.

A Homeland Security officer is left shaken by an encounter with an otherworldly intruder inside an empty government building. A long-dead soldier saves a life. Meanwhile, paramedics respond to a ghostly 911 call.

The ghost of a young girl follows a police officer home from the scene of an accident. A spirit plays tricks on a deputy at an Alabama mansion, and a paramedic is shocked to see the apparition of a bride and groom walking down the aisle of a church.

With their armies fully engaged on the battlegrounds, the Allied and Axis powers focused their efforts to develop new weapons and new strategies to deliver a knockout blow to the enemy and bring about a quick end to the conflict.
After Hitler's gamble in the East fails, the Soviet Union starts to slowly push back and grow.

By early 1944, Hitler had long been expecting an Allied attack on north-western France, but his problem was knowing when and where it would come. This episode has a look at the Allied operations Bodyguard and Overlord.
Concentrates on Hitler's attempts to shift the balance of power back in his favour.
The war in the Pacific against Japan was a savage hand-to-hand, island-to-island struggle, fought by new specialist fighting units like the valiant Chindits.
Allied forces converge on Germany, uncovering the horrors of Belsen and Buchenwald, before pushing towards Berlin, where Adolf Hitler is clinging to power in his last desperate days.
The US Navy trained nearly 15,000 pilots on Lake Michigan from 1942-1945, resulting in the sinking of more than 100 classic World War II fighters and dive bombers.
The documentary details the Bismarck's search and sinking, featuring naval historians and Angus Konstam.

In April 1945, as Stalin's Red Army approach from the east and the western Allied forces quickly approach through France and Belgium, Adolf Hitler awaits his fate in his bunker, reflecting on the mistakes that lost him the war.

Hungarian Jews Magda Brown and George Brent, who survived the Auschwitz-Birkenau concentration camp as teenagers, reveal the human aspects of survival, resistance, chance, and luck in the face of Nazi tyranny.
Hoping to find a sense of normalcy, six female Holocaust survivors immigrate to America, get married and raise children.

A look at some of the personal items and belongings left behind in Auschwitz Birkenau, including a baby doll, Elsa Ury's suitcase, camp children's tales, the gas chamber door, Karl Hocker's album, a cracked thermos flask, and an SS Licence Plate.
A sobering look at some of the personal items and belongings left behind in Auschwitz Birkenau, a former Nazi concentration and extermination camp and the world's largest cemetery.

A sobering look at some of the personal items and belongings left behind in Auschwitz Birkenau including a sketchbook, various stolen objects, a little white house, Hoss's gallows, Roma portraits, and a double portrait.

A sobering look at some of the personal items and belongings left behind in Auschwitz Birkenau, including a little shoe and suitcase, the central sauna, collar tabs, Bilderbuch and Sonderkommando photos.
A sobering look at some of the personal items and belongings left behind in Auschwitz Birkenau, including soup kettles, a snuff box, the crematorium furnace, the camp model and a Totenbuch.

A documentary that sheds light on the Holocaust experience from the perspective of six women imprisoned in the Auschwitz-Birkenau concentration camp. The film demonstrates the Nazis' failure to crush the will of Jews. The women profiled do not dwell on the physical and emotional hardships. Instead, they speak of camp families and faith, and the ways in which they tried to encourage one another and retain their humanity in the face of unimaginable evil.

Investigative documentary exploring the construction of the Mauthausen concentration camp. In 1938, Hitler ordered the construction of the camp, one of the deadliest in history. Some 200,000 people would be deported there. Over 120,000 would perish.
In York, Professor Alice Roberts takes part in a Viking battle, meets the metal detectorists behind one of the UK's greatest archaeological finds, and gets her hands on Viking poo.
Alice discovers things at Norwich Castle Museum which highlight facts about Tudor life, Anglo-Saxon childbirth rituals, and the Pompeii of the Bronze Age.
A look back at the best archaeological findings of 2014, including the Barrow Clump, Ipplepen and Winchester sites.
Kevin Sempé dives in search of wrecks harking back to the Roman Empire's greatness. The journey begins with the Nave Romana.
Kevin Sempé explores the bay of Saint-Pierre in Martinique, where ships smouldered and sank following the devastating volcanic eruption of 1902.

Alice tells the story of Norman England by studying the history of Winchester, Britain's most Norman city. Alice attempts to storm a castle in chain mail, investigates the origins of modern surgery and tucks in to an appetising eel pie.
In Norwich, the UK's most Tudor city, Professor Alice Roberts learns about religious intolerance, uncovers the Norwich FC canary's origins and experiences humiliating Tudor justice.

Andy visits Worcestershire to honour his childhood rock hero, explores a gender-biased cave, and unravels the mystery of "Who Put Bella in the Wych Elm?" He later meets a treasure hunter and enjoys May Day Morris dancing.

Andy and Dr Kate Cherrell explore Nottingham's eerie museum with creepy dolls and a haunted hearse. They visit the rumoured haunted National Justice Museum and learn about Robin Hood and a cursed galleon at an old pub.

A look at the biggest collection of Roman writing tablets in Britain, giving insight into what Roman London was really like. Off the coast of Kent, a dive into the English Channel reveals the biggest marine excavation since the Mary Rose, an 18th-century East India Company ship packed with silver.

Alice discovers the well-preserved writing tablets, swords and domestic items left by Romans at Vindolanda during a time of British rebellion. On the Scottish island of Iona, there are traces of a long-lost monastery and pilgrimage site that was originally built by the legendary Saint Columba, and has been compared to Jerusalem. In the east of Scotland, a weapons hoard belonging to a wealthy Bronze Age warrior is unearthed.
Dan Jones visits the heart of the English countryside to explore Arundel Castle and the dramatic history of the Earls of Arundel.

Dan Jones visits Lancaster Castle to explore its grisly history of crime and punishment, including the infamous Lancashire Witches trials and the martyrdom of the Jesuit priest Saint Edmund Arrowsmith.
Alice enjoys a Roman feast in Britain's most Roman city, Chester. She examines a radical theory on the Romans' plans for the city and explores an incredible archaeological find deep underground.
Kevin dives into the blue waters of the Caribbean to find the relics that litter the sea floor from piracy's heyday in the region.
Kevin embarks on a challenging dive in the Atlantic Ocean to explore a battleship that saved the Northern Navy in the American Civil War.
Explore how the Polynesians spread across the Pacific and examine the cultures they took with them while constructing elaborate temples to their beliefs.

The Inca, a vast late medieval civilisation in Peru and nearby regions, fell to Spanish conquest in 1533. Despite agricultural and architectural feats, they lacked military tech and disease immunity to resist invaders.

Robert hat italienische Wurzeln und will nach Italien ziehen. Doch seine Frau Laura befürchtet, als Außenseiterin dazustehen. Als die beiden nach einem Zuhause suchen, stellen sie schnell fest, dass Roberts Plan Laura unberücksichtigt lässt.

Ein erfolgreiches Paar zieht aus New York auf die hügelige Karibikinsel St. Martin. Das neue Heim soll ihr Traumhaus mit ihrem Arbeitsplatz vereinen. Doch die beiden haben unterschiedliche Vorstellungen ihres neuen Zuhauses.

Vor fünf Jahren begannen Cab und Lisa, die Halbinsel Baja in Mexiko zu besuchen. Sie waren fasziniert von den Stränden, den Weinbergen und der Nähe zu San Diego. Als sie jedoch nach Immobilien suchten, zeigten sich ihre verschiedenen Vorstellungen.

Donna und Curtis wollen sich mit ihrem Lottogewinn in Massachusetts zur Ruhe setzen und suchen ein Haus möglichst nah am See und nicht weiter als 45 Minuten von Hopkinton entfernt. Häuser in dieser Lage sind allerdings sehr gefragt.

Die jungvermählten Berufstätigen und Tierliebhaber Sophie, Tim und ihre beiden Hunde wollen unbedingt aus seiner engen Wohnung herauskommen, aber angesichts ihrer Wunschliste bedarf es eines kleinen Wunders, um eine perfekte Immobilie zu finden.
Katie und Michael träumen von einem geräumigeren Zuhause für sich und ihre drei Töchter.

Ein verlobtes junges Paar sucht in einer schicken Gegend in Florida nach einem renovierungsbedürftigen Haus. Das zukünftige Zuhause am Wasser soll noch vor der Hochzeit renoviert werden, damit genug Platz für die Familienplanung ist.

Eine Familie begibt sich auf die Suche nach einem barrierefreien Haus in den Outer Banks von North Carolina. Die Gegend ist normalerweise sehr teuer, doch die Familie hat Glück. Doch nun stehen einige Renovierungsarbeiten an.

Eine Familie verlässt ihr angemietetes Ferienhaus und will stattdessen ein neues Traumhaus auf Rhode Island kaufen. Die Käufer finden ein passendes Anwesen. Dieses benötigt allerdings einige Renovierungsarbeiten, die ans Geld gehen.

Inmitten des historischen Stadtteils Sunset Hills haben Tamaras neue Kunden ein Haus zum Schnäppchenpreis ergattert. Das zweistöckige 400 m² große Anwesen im Tudor-Stil stammt aus dem Jahr 1955 und muss dringend renoviert werden.

Tamaras Bekannter Marc hat in einer begehrten Gegend ein baufälliges und unbewohnbares Haus erworben. Er will es sanieren und wieder verkaufen und Tamara hilft dabei, der preiswerten Villa den Glanz zu verleihen, den sie verdient.

Ein alleinerziehender Vater möchte für sich und seine drei Töchter ein Traumhaus errichten, das einem Märchenschloss gleicht. Diese umfangreiche Renovierung steckt voller einzigartiger Designüberraschungen, die sich für Könige eignen.

Die 79-jährige Charmaine hat über Jahrzehnte Erinnerungsstücke gesammelt, die ihr kleines Stadthaus überfüllen. Ihre Tochter Hetty will mit Enkelin Maya zu Besuch kommen, doch dafür muss Charmaine sich von ihren Sachen trennen, um Raum zu schaffen.
Kanoa Lloyd und das Team helfen der Mutter eines behinderten Sohnes, die im Chaos versinkt.

In Arkansas benötigt eine Siedlerfamilie dringend Hilfe. Im Spätwinter schlägt das Wetter in den unwirtlichen Ozark Mountains gnadenlos zu. Ashli und Chris Curry sind die Aufgaben längst über den Kopf gewachsen: Es mangelt an Trinkwasser.

Jay und Pattie Crum haben sich ihren Traum erfüllt und sind auf eine entlegene Ranch mitten in der Wildnis Montanas gezogen. Doch ihr Grundstück ist nur über einen 16 Kilometer langen Feldweg zu erreichen, der regelmäßig von Felsen oder Baumstämmen blockiert wird. Da Jay an Epilepsie leidet, sitzt das Paar bei möglichen medizinischen Notfällen praktisch in der Falle. Die Outdoor-Experten aus Alaska eilen den Crums zur Hilfe, um sie bei der Sicherung ihrer Lebensgrundlage zu unterstützen.

Chase Morrill muss zusammen mit seinem Team in West Bath an einem Auftrag arbeiten. Und die Liste der Aufgaben ist endlos: Fenster, Sanitäranlagen, eine Küche und Schränke - all das für das künftige Urlaubsdomizil von Tina Seners.

Rod Hiltz ist ein Naturbursche. Er genießt die ruhige und entspannende Zeit im Grünen. Das spiegelt auch seine Immobilie wider. Doch es gibt ein Manko: Er muss immer durch den Wald laufen, um zum Plumpsklo zu gelangen. Das soll ein Ende haben.

Jack beginnt seine Reise in Nebraska und besichtigt ein aufwendig renoviertes Raketensilo. Danach besucht er ein märchenhaftes Cottage mit Hollywood-Vergangenheit und entdeckt zum Abschluss in Las Vegas ein außergewöhnliches Paradies für Autofans.

Martin Roberts meets one of two young brothers busy building a property portfolio in Bolsover, Derbyshire, while Dion Dublin checks out a three-bedroom semi in Wolverhampton, and Lucy Alexander is impressed by plans to convert a two-bedroom, fire-damaged terraced house in London's Plaistow into a smart five-bedroom property.

Dion Dublin has a hair-raising experience at a barber's in Rochdale, Lancashire, while Martin Roberts looks round a great bungalow in Alsager, Cheshire, and Lucy Alexander sees all the potential in a piece of land in Eccles in Kent.

Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin visit a one-bedroom flat in Catford, London, a large house near the River Mersey and a semi-detached property in Alvaston in Derby.

A large piece of land in Ratby in Leicestershire, a terrace in Chesterton in Staffordshire and a 1930s semi with a huge garden and huge potential are all sold at auction. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin meet the developers hoping to breathe new life into their auction buys.

A two-bedroom detached house in Basford in Nottingham, a top-floor flat in Portsmouth and a large Edwardian terrace in Crewe are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and hear about their plans.

A multimillion-pound development in Farningham in Kent, an ambitious, total renovation project in Aspatria in Cumbria and a very small studio flat in Wallington in Surrey are all sold under the hammer. Martin and Lucy meet the new owners to discuss their plans.
