A three-bedroom house in Borrowash in Derbyshire, another three-bedder in West Bromwich in the Midlands and a quirky four-bedroom house on the Isle of Sheppey are all sold under the hammer.

A flat in Pegswood in Northumberland, a terrace in Swadlincote in Derbyshire and a former shop in Chatham in Kent are all sold under the hammer. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin meet the new owners and hear their renovation plans.
A mid-terrace house in Wales, a basement office in Central London with a huge price tag and two flats in Bootle near Liverpool are all sold under the hammer.

Lucy meets a young couple expecting a baby who have to weigh up whether to live in their auction buy in Sydenham in London. Martin talks to a man and his father-in-law who have bought their first property together in Trentham near Stoke. Also, Dion meets a man who only went into property development after he retired. His latest buy is a three-bed semi in West Bromwich.

Terraced houses in Tunstall in Shropshire and Prescott in Liverpool and a large flat in Dagenham are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion have a look round before hearing what the new owners have planned.

A chiropodist, two part-time gardeners and a woman who works on projects in between the school run are today's investors. They've bought property in Bullbridge in Derbyshire, Newcastle-under-Lyme in Staffordshire and Wolverhampton in the West Midlands under the hammer.

Harri and Claire Chiba own the Vale of Berkeley Guesthouse in Gloucestershire. On arrival, Craig and Alec Coleman are left cold by the minimalist, magnolia decor, while artistic duo Charlie and Justin aren't thrilled with the no-frills toilet.

Day two of the competition is at Artist Residence in Penzance, Cornwall. The guests generally like the quirky nature of the art-filled rooms, but Blackpool veterans Craig and Alec Coleman think their room is too modern and find a hole in the ceiling.
Third to host are couple Alec and Craig Coleman of the award-winning Edenfield Guesthouse in Blackpool. Craig plans to reveal his cabaret-star alter-ego Sybil Du Vuax to his unsuspecting guests.

Day four of the competition is at The New Inn at Portland in Dorset, run by publicans and husband and wife team Stacey and Spencer Cullum. The hosts decide to show their guests a typical island activity - sandcastle building.
It's the final day of the competition, and it is time for the B&B'ers to settle some scores. After dramatic discoveries and cutting comments, the payments are revealed, and the winner is announced.
Kicking off in the valleys is cleaning company owner, Kelly Anne, who hopes her simple menu of classic comfort foods with a spritz of glitz will secure her a victory.
Bar manager and former child actor Ryan hopes to be a grand richer by the end of the week, but will his ambitious grub put him on the podium or end up in the bin?
This time, it's the turn of local radio host Rachel, but despite things getting off to a bad start, she is undeterred and expects her Indian-themed menu to bag her the grand prize.
This time, it is accountant Runa's turn to host. She is hoping her Bangladeshi-inspired menu will wow her guests, but she has underestimated radio DJ Rachel who is out for revenge.
Energy consultant David serves classic dinner party fare, but two guests refuse to eat his offal-based starter and one is chastised for using the wrong sort of cutlery at the table.
Mark Canny hosts at The Bowling Green in Chorlton, where some of his guests rave about the newly refurbished rooms, but others find faults. And a fridge feud leaves Mark far from chilled.
James and Fiona host at their pole-perched premier pods at Redhill Holidays in Whitbourne. Some of their guests are bowled over by the surroundings, but others are bugged by creepy-crawlies.
Andrew and Qidi host at the Mode Lytham Hotel in Lytham, where they hope to bag best in show. But some problematic parking and a 'grab-and-go' breakfast don't do it for everyone.
Petra and Martin welcome their guests to Villa Farm Cottage in Thornton Curtis, where the bathroom tiles make one guest nostalgic and a generous breakfast leaves everyone spoilt for choice.
It's the last day of the competition. After dramatic discoveries and score-settling on everything from noisy fridges to parking, the payments are revealed, and the winner is announced.
While Mike and Frank are picking and dreaming in California, Mike falls for the sweetest classic Ford pick-up he's ever seen.

Will Cavalier King Charles Spaniel Lance's bad habit put a dampener on Charlotte's dream? Sad Staffy Dimity needs a new pooch pal. And is cattle dog cross Bonnie the right fit for a fast-paced family?
Gold-winning Olympic cyclist Victoria Pendleton visits Wood Green to find a dog she can co-parent with her mum. And lovebirds Shai and Orin meet Polo the lurcher.

With more cameras in parts of Chester Zoo that visitors never see, revealing the private lives of animals as never before. The keepers think pregnant elephant Thi is three months overdue. Giraffe Meru relentlessly chases the females in his herd.
A desperate farmer takes hostages to save his cattle from being shot after four of the herd are diagnosed with tuberculosis. A tense rural standoff ensues.

Patients and staff reflect on getting older and coming to terms with mortality. Brian, who's 74, is brought into King's by ambulance after falling backwards down a flight of stairs and being knocked unconscious.

A look at older patients who've had to show resilience in their lives. Ellen, who's 86, has been brought in by ambulance after her daughters, Carole and Janet, found her collapsed on the floor at home.

A serious TV newscaster's life changes when he meets his young superfan and the boy's hardworking single mum. As he embraces positive holiday stories, romance blooms - but a career opportunity forces him to choose between ambition and love.
Sparks fly between two lifelong Buffalo Bills fans as they try to discover the identity of a mysterious Christmas gift-giver.
A loving couple shares the story of how they met and fell in love when their daughter's boyfriend comes to meet them for the first time at Christmas.
After a brief courtship, Celeste and Jason get engaged. Celeste then asks her pastor father, who's not ready to let his daughter go, to officiate their Christmas wedding.
Three couples celebrate the holiday season while navigating crucial turning points in their lives.

Four days before Christmas, Elizabeth Athens receives a voicemail from a number she doesn't recognise. On the message, a man she doesn't know makes one final plea for the love of his life to give him a second chance.

In 1951, a wartime doctor tries to make Christmas special for his worried wife. In 2003, a newly married couple host two sets of in-laws for Christmas Eve. In 2024, a couple try to arrange special holiday surprises for each other.
When Emily wishes for a perfect Christmas like the ones found in the popular Sugarplum movies, she's shocked when Sugarplum herself appears to help her fulfil it.
Forget Tony Hawk, Slater and Hayley have their own skate park in their backyard.

Catelynn is at odds with her family over her choice of adoption, while Amber and fiancé Gary are having serious issues within their relationship. Farrah discovers that dating as a teenage mother is problematic and Maci, now single, struggles to balance motherhood and school when her friends leave for college.

Leah breaks up with Jason, and Jenelle's plans to take Jace on a mother-son trip go awry. Briana leaves Luis alone with Stella for the first time. Kailyn gets child support advice from TMOG's Amber, and Chelsea tends to a sick Watson.
Kelli and Judy have announcements to share; a veteran gives a surprising and heartfelt goodbye.

Years ago, Mike met Kristen on Facebook. They quickly forged a deep connection, but Mike's frequent efforts to meet Kristen have been futile. He's convinced she could be the one. Will Mike finally get face-to-face with Kristen?
A teen's roommate accuses her of stealing his laptop and vandalising their apartment. A boy denies breaking his former girlfriend's brand-new media player.
Neighbours blame each other when their cars collide. Clients sue a private investigator for the return of fees.
A woman says that her family vandalised her car, and former friends fight over liability for car damages.
Unwed parents feud over damages incurred in an assault during a child-custody exchange, and a woman says she was intimate with her boyfriend after he vandalized her car.

As the sisters enjoy the peaceful new utopia, Leo realises that their conflict-free world comes at a terrible price they had not anticipated. He joins forces with Zankou to reverse the change and Brody is rewarded for his heroism.
Paige is hiring new professors for the Magic School and encounters a demon who has struck a deal with a sorcerer to become human.
Nev and Kamie receive an anonymous email from a whistleblower reporting a catfishing. But when our hosts arrive to help the named victim, they uncover a deeper conspiracy of deception.
A pregnant teen is sued for medical bills and property damage after she assaults another teen; a man sues former residents for leaving his duplex a mess.

A hit-and-run accident on the motorway and an alleged case of mistaken identity are disputed by feuding motorists. An allegedly stolen tax refund that was deposited into a two-year-old girl's bank account divides former friends.

A woman is suing her ex-fiancé for a loan to buy her engagement ring and down payments on a wedding reception and a home. He sues for the balance on her wedding dress. Child endangerment is the accusation laid against a nanny who sues her former employer for payment of her fee, lost wages and bank fees.
A woman's expensive lingerie goes missing; a man beats a pit bull after it attacks him.
A ghost possesses Darryl's friend, so Phoebe and Drake travel back to 1899 to the cabaret fire where the man was killed.
Piper is attacked by demons armed with thorns and ends up in a coma, but as she hovers between life and death, her spirit encounters a familiar face from the past.
A landlord and a former tenant argue over sexual advances, drunken behaviour and rent. Another tenant accuses her ex-landlord of starting a fire that damaged her property.
A woman's family accuses her of abandoning a child and defaulting on a car loan. An ex-girlfriend wants a man to repay a loan.
Mia makes a surprise return, Chloe rebels, Sassi struggles back at home and Megan faces her feelings. Shannon and Charlie go house-hunting while Amber sleeps on the streets.
The tattoo fixers get a visit from TOWIE fan Ash, whose Joey Essex-inspired tattoo is far from 'reem', and Alice helps rid ex-club rep Sammie of an unladylike error on her lady parts.
A hitchhiker spots a pattern of lights and is terrified when they seem to attack him. A sighting in France becomes one of the most investigated cases in UFO history.
Examine a hat emblazoned with teeth, a box with the power to kill, and a golden quiver from a Macedonian tomb.
In Michigan, a father and son see strange lights and call the sheriff's office. In France, a craft known as Angel Hair is spotted hovering over school grounds.
On Halloween night in 2004 the police receive over 50 UFO reports in the Chicago area. And in Buck's County, a contractor sees a large object pass over his home.
US Air Force reservists are pursued by lights while flying back to their base. Plus, constable Godfrey loses consciousness when he investigates a strange disruption.

In 1964, while Charles James Hall was stationed at Nellis Air Force Base in Nevada, he encountered an alien race he refers to as the "Tall Whites". He claims they were working with the US military and housed a spaceship in a secret hangar nearby.
During the Cold War, sinister objects were seen flying above secret military bases. Were aliens monitoring the world's nuclear arsenal?
On February 25, 1942, the skies over the sprawling city of Los Angeles erupt like a volcano. Anti-aircraft weapons fire wildly at strange targets.
Featuring a dogfight between alien aircraft and the US Air Force, the world's loudest sounds and a fishing trawler.
A window washer falls nearly 50 stories and rocks and boulders move on their own.
A ghost ship is found on a remote island, home to one of Earth's last uncontacted tribes. New evidence reveals a mysterious military compound in Russia.

Can satellite images help identify the hiding place of the Nazi Gold Train? Also, a blood-red river in Siberia points to pollution on a catastrophic scale and a discovery of a long-lost settlement rewrites the history of the Vikings in North America.

Craig and Sarah take on the US Navy's Unidentified Aerial Phenomenon videos: the 'Tic-Tac' footage, filmed from the USS Nimitz in 2004, and the 'Go-Fast' and 'Gimbal' videos filmed between 2014 and 2015 from the USS Theodore Roosevelt.

Craig and Sarah pore over every scrap of available evidence relating to the Rendlesham incident, including the audio recording made by Lieutenant Colonel Charles Halt when he and a patrol of men investigated lights in the forest that fateful night.
Governments around the world investigate UFO sightings, but many of them keep it a secret from the public.
Alien abductees reveal details about the insides of UFOs and help researchers understand how aliens live and what they want from the human race.

On a September morning in 1994, students at a Zimbabwe school witness a silver craft land in a nearby field. Numerous adults corroborate the UFO sighting, but the children are silenced. Many maintain their account of the incident is true.
60 years on, Tony's close encounter has become an obsession. Meanwhile, pilot David presents photographic evidence of the UFO he almost crashed into whilst flying near area 5.
Adam, Gwen and Julie recall personal encounters with UFOs, before experts' theories are put in doubt when we learn that each individual has time missing from their encounters.
An abandoned city in remote jungles could be the home of an ancient treasure. Also, could a mysterious stone circle be the fabled round table of King Arthur?
When experts investigate a network of tunnels rumoured to be the hiding place of lost royal treasure, they find evidence of human sacrifice for a Viking god.

Several UFOs suddenly appear above Swedish power plants and other places. Some believe that the country will soon be the target of an attack. A soldier claims to have encountered a UFO years ago and receives compensation from the US military.

A fleet of UFOs is filmed over the South China Sea, a 12,000-year-old archaeological site reveals carvings of alien, six-fingered humanoids, and a recorded confession claims that Albert Einstein made a secret visit to Roswell in 1947 to see a crashed UFO and its dead and dying occupants.

Dein Morgen, dein Rhythmus: Das Nachrichtenmagazin begleitet die Zuschauer täglich mit verständlich eingeordneten Themen aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Sport und Service. Spannende Talks sorgen für Unterhaltung und Information.

Berichtet wird über aktuelle Themen des Tages und die wichtigsten Entwicklungen in der Welt. Zudem werden Hintergründe und Einschätzungen von Politikern und Experten geliefert und es wird zusammengefasst, was die Menschen bewegt.

Die Sendung behandelt aktuelle Wirtschafts-, Verbraucher- und Finanzthemen, erklärt Hintergründe und ordnet Entwicklungen ein. Experten und Reporter aus Frankfurt und New York berichten über Trends und Bewegungen an den Finanzmärkten.
Das Nachrichtenmagazin berichtet über die aktuellsten Ereignisse und spezielle Themen.

Das Magazin nimmt Themenfelder wie etwa Energiekosten oder Lebensmittelpreise unter die Lupe, die in Zukunft für den Alltag und somit für alle immer wichtiger werden. Darüber hinaus gibt das Magazin nützliche Tipps für das tägliche Leben.

Beleuchtet werden Themen aus aller Welt und es Menschen und Geschichten hinter den Schlagzeilen aus der ganzen Welt gezeigt. Berichtet wird über beispielsweise über Atomversuche, Flüchtlinge und viele weitere Ereignisse rund um den Globus.

Start-ups gewinnen als wichtiger Impulsgeber für Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft zunehmend an Bedeutung. Dieses Magazin widmet sich in jeder Ausgabe jeweils einem Thema, das Janna Linke gemeinsam mit einem Experten von verschiedenen Seiten beleuchtet.

In der Pampa Patagoniens wird der Bahnverkehr häufig durch umherziehende Schafe unterbrochen. Grund genug für die Wunderländer, ein witziges Gimmick für die größte Modelleisenbahnanlage der Welt zu bauen. Die Idee: ein Zug soll durch eine Schafherde fahren und diese scheinbar zur Seite treiben. Die technische Umsetzung: eine echte Herausforderung. Knifflig ist auch die Arbeit an der Wellenmaschine, dem neuen Multimedia-Highlight der Anlage.

Nach vier Jahren Bauzeit steht die Eröffnung Patagoniens kurz bevor. Doch der Bahnverkehr läuft alles andere als reibungslos. Die Profis des Wunderlandes arbeiten im Akkord, um die weltgrößte Modelleisenbahn auch im neuen Abschnitt zum Laufen zu bringen. Derweil setzen die Modellbauer die letzten Knopfdruckattraktionen in die Anlage ein. Vom rauchenden Gaucho-Grillfest bis zum beweglichen Wal - Endspurt für die Wunderland-Crew.

In der Formel 1 und im Indy 500 wird ein talentierter Fahrer schwer verletzt. Auf einer gefährlichen Strecke lässt er sein Leben. Die anspruchsvollen Routen Europas und Amerikas haben ihre Tücken und führen zu Motorsportunfällen.

Diese Dokumentation stellt schief gelaufene Expeditionen in den Vordergrund. Dabei auch die Umrundung der Erde von Amelia Earhart oder die Everest-Katastrophe von 1996. Es sind fesselnde Geschichten und tragische Ereignisse.

Archäologen sind fasziniert von den Pyramiden von Gizeh - dem einzig erhaltenen antiken Weltwunder. Seit über 200 Jahren rätseln sie, wie sie einst von den Ägyptern erbaut wurden. Zudem ist nach wie vor unklar, was sich darunter befindet.

An den Stränden von Namibias Skelettküste sind verrostete Gerätschaften und bleiche Knochen die makabren Überbleibsel einer Industrie, die einst Licht in die Welt brachte - und dafür ganze Walbestände auslöschte. Zwischen Sand.

Entlang der 2.000 Meilen langen Grenze zwischen Texas und Mexiko arbeiten Grenzbeamte an einem der sensibelsten Übergänge der Welt. Täglich müssen sie den legalen Verkehr ermöglichen und gleichzeitig gefährliche Schmuggelware stoppen. Wir begleiten sie bei riskanten Einsätzen, einer heiklen Übergabe mutmaßlicher Kartellmitglieder, bewegenden Asylgeschichten und Momenten, in denen persönliche Schicksale auf harte Grenzrealität treffen.

Als bei einer routinemäßigen Röntgenuntersuchung verdächtige Pakete entdeckt werden, die in den Reifen eines Kleinlasters versteckt sind, werden die Beamten skeptisch. Außerdem beschlagnahmen sie eine große Ladung Marihuana.

Über der sturmgepeitschten Nordsee wird eine Turboprop-Maschine vom Blitz getroffen. Im Cockpit fallen die Instrumente aus, das Flugzeug rast in die Tiefe, der Aufprall scheint unausweichlich. Bei der Untersuchung wird etwas Ungewöhnliches entdeckt.

Ein Privatjet befindet sich im Anflug auf den Flughafen von Akron im US-Bundesstaat Ohio. Kurz vor dem Ziel kommt es zur Katastrophe: Die Maschine knallt in ein Apartmentgebäude, alle Insassen sterben. Die Ermittler untersuchen, wie es dazu kam.

Drei Orte, drei Geschichten: In Bolivien zeigt der verschwundene Gletscher von Chacaltaya die Folgen des Klimawandels. In Belgien wird der Ort Doel zum Symbol des Widerstands. Und in Liberia erinnert ein Wolkenkratzer an das Ende der Sklaverei.

Das Dew Drop Inn in New Orleans markiert einen Fixpunkt der US-amerikanischen Musikgeschichte. Ray Charles, Little Richard und Ella Fitzgerald standen dort einst auf der Bühne. Zudem wird noch das Fort Belgica in Indonesien erkundet.

Ein Schiff trotzt den Wellen - und dem Gesetz. Jahrzehntelang funkt der legendäre Piratensender Radio Caroline von Bord der "Ross Revenge" gegen die musikalische Einfalt in Großbritannien an - bis zum brutalen Zugriff der Behörden. Ein Luxushotel in Beirut wird zum Schlachtfeld, Stockwerk für Stockwerk, jahrelang. Außerdem geht es um ein russisch-orthodoxes Freizeitdorf mit Zwiebelturmkirche, verlassen ganz weit außerhalb in Japan. Ein arabischer Traum aus 1001 Nacht wird zum Albtraum.

Schwerlast-Selbstfahrer gelten als Transportwunder. Ihre Motoren haben mehr als fünfhundert PS und ihr wendiges Fahrwerk besitzt acht Räder pro Achslinie. Damit können sie nicht nur vorwärts und rückwärts, sondern auch seitwärts und diagonal fahren.

Das Campen begann als authentischer Natururlaub und wurde Jahre später zum extravaganten Luxustourismus. Anstatt das Notwendigste mit sich zu tragen, geht nun das voll möblierte Heim mit auf Reisen. Wer sind die Besitzer dieser teuren Wohnmobile?

In dieser Sendung geht es um die gigantische Betonkonstruktion der neuen Samuel-De-Champlain-Brücke, die über dem Sankt-Lorenz-Strom im kanadischen Quebec gebaut wurde. Täglich passieren tausende Fahrzeuge auf dieser Doppelschrägseilbrücke.

Wer würde sich nicht gerne mal wie ein Superheld fühlen? Mit dem Jetsuit eines britischen Unternehmens kann man sich mühelos in die Lüfte erheben und über den Himmel jagen. Der Harvesterkopf einer finnischen Firma fällt und entastet einen Baum binnen Sekunden und unterstützt obendrein eine verantwortungsvolle Forstwirtschaft. Und ein 3D-Drucker aus Dänemark erschafft auf Knopfdruck perfekt designte Häuser aus schnelltrocknendem Beton in fast jeder gewünschten Form.

Polizeibeamte kontrollieren routinemäßig einen Pick-up-Truck. Dort entdecken sie illegaler Substanzen. Und: Ein Krimineller soll an das mexikanische Militär übergeben werden. Die Ermittler suchen dafür eine passende Transportroute.

Die Beamten der Biosicherheitskontrolle überprüfen in Laredo einige Paletten aus Mexiko. Die Kollegen überprüfen derweil ein Taxi. Darin befindet sich eine Dame, die zwei schwere Gepäckstücke bei sich hat. Die Ermittler wollen Genaueres herausfinden.

Ein Angler aus der Ukraine und eine junge Frau aus Brasilien geraten ins Visier der Zollbeamten. An den Flughäfen Auckland und Queenstown machen Beamte Funde, die die Biosicherheit des Kontinents und Landes gefährden können.
Eine Kanadierin unternimmt den Versuch, eine Katze über die Grenze zu schmuggeln und ein Niederländer wird mit einer immensen Menge an Kokain aufgegriffen.

Die neuseeländischen Grenzschutzbeamten kontrollieren drei israelische Männer, die große Mengen MDMA mit sich führen. Weiterhin stellt sich heraus, dass die Touristen sich auch anderweitig vergnügen: Sie verbringen ihre Urlaubszeit gerne in Sexklubs.

Der Versuch, Alkohol zu schmuggeln, wird von den Zollbeamten in den Häfen von Auckland vereitelt. Ein kurdischer Neuseeländer erzählt von seinen großen Abenteuern in Risikoländern und eine Französin gerät außer sich und in Rage.

Neuseelands Grenzschützer und Spürhunde überwachen Einreisende, Gepäck, Post und Fracht auf Schmuggelware und Biosicherheitsrisiken. Von Auckland bis Queenstown zeigt die Doku ihre akribische Arbeit zum Schutz der Inselnation.

Die Zollbeamten am internationalen Flughafen von Christchurch verdächtigen das Gepäck eines Kanadiers. Weiterhin bemerken sie ein ungewöhnlich farbenfrohes Päckchen aus Uganda. Schließlich belügt eine Philippinerin die Beamten.
Eine Brasilianerin verhält sich verdächtig. Ein Reisender gibt den Beamten einen hilfreichen Tipp.

Die Beamten fassen einen Chinesen, der mehr Zigaretten als erlaubt transportiert. Weiterhin verdächtigen sie eine Fracht mit Kupferdraht. Es stellt sich heraus, dass dort die Droge Crystal Meth versteckt eingeschmuggelt wird.
Der Grenzschutz sucht Prostituierte aus Hongkong ab. Ein illegaler Waffentransport wird aufgedeckt.
Die Spürhunde lenken die Aufmerksamkeit des Grenzschutzes auf ein Paket aus Brasilien.
Eine Frau aus Hongkong wird verdächtigt, da sie zur Besichtigung eines zerstörten Hauses anreist.
On 28 July 2010, Airblue Flight 202 crashed into the Margalla Hills while attempting to land at Benazir Bhutto International Airport in poor weather conditions, killing all 152 people on board.
A Boeing 737 crashes moments after taking off from an airport in the Algerian desert.
Off the coast of the Philippines, undersea explorers aboard RV Petrel detect a wreck that fits the profile of an American destroyer. Is it the USS Ward known for firing America's first WWII shot?
Tim Shaw and master mechanic Fuzz Townshend restore a beloved 1963 Alfa Romeo Giulia Spider, a two-seater convertible that's a masterstroke of 1960s Italian design flair.
Immerse yourself in the impressive world of Dutch engineering. From the country's largest storm surge barrier to the secrets of the world-famous Kinderdijk windmills.
Singapore Airlines Flight 006 prepares to take off from Taipei's Chang Kai-shek Airport. But moments later the aircraft spins around violently, crashes and breaks apart.
May 1941: The new Nazi battleship Bismarck sets out to destroy Allied convoys in the Atlantic. It is up to the Royal Navy to stop it in its tracks.
In 1942, Japan came to dominate the Pacific region and inflict huge blows on the Allies. The secret as to how they did it lies waiting to be discovered.
In Athens, experts race to restore the Parthenon, while across the Mediterranean, archaeologists uncover the story of the civilization that built it.
The tow truckers get a new enemy, Mother Nature, as sudden changes in temperatures throw up unforeseen challenges for the ice road rescuers.
The 2004 tsunami was the most devastating natural disaster of our time. What contributed to the magnitude of the killer wave, and how can a similar tragedy be prevented?
On 12 April 1990, Widerøe Flight 839 crashed into the water shortly after takeoff from Værøy Airport in Norway, killing all five people on board.
Out-of-control wildfires rip through Australia during the 2019 Black Summer.
Earthquake-proof buildings fall down in Turkey. Two gantry cranes bump into each other. A battery factory blows up, and a bridge collapses in Dresden.
In 1992, Flight 1862 from Amsterdam to Tel Aviv suffered a catastrophic crash. Investigators discover a lethal problem threatening every 747.
Investigators examine similarities between a crash landing at Tokyo's Narita Airport and an accident at Newark Airport more than a decade earlier.
A cat comforts the other creatures at an animal shelter, two pygmy goats play with a Chihuahua, and a Rhodesian ridgeback helps raise a cheetah.
The docs pin a goose, unhook a dog and help a tegu.
Catching a black mamba at midnight is only part of Simon and Siouxsie's latest challenge. They also bring 25 baby rock pythons into the world.
Three surfers and a kayaker encounter tiger sharks off Oahu. The team investigates their hunting patterns to discover what is causing these incidents.
A small but loyal family of wild dogs look for a safe place to raise six tiny puppies. The sanctuary they seek is filled with rivals and potential predators, and they are outsized and outnumbered.
The Schroeders' son Charlie is flying the coop and heading to college.

Drop into the secret life of the honey badger as Badgie learns how to face the wilds of Africa alone. Join her at ground level on mouse, snake and scorpion hunts, and watch her battle a porcupine for ownership of her burrow. Badgers are famous for being the most fearless animals in Africa, and in this film we follow her rite of passage to becoming the street fighter of the Savannah.
An epic biopic of one female wolf, following her against-the-odds rise to a position of extraordinary power for a female: leader of her pack.
Soaring cliffs, canyons and water shape a diverse wildlife refuge in Zion.
Police agents in El Dorado have to act quickly to intercept a shipment of cleverly hidden drugs that a trio of women has concealed in their handbags. A passenger has to be rushed to the hospital.
Dr. Oakley treats a miracle moose, a Doberman puppy that was hit by a car, and an unusually tiny patient.
The greatest gatherings of wildlife on the planet battle constant change.
Africa is a land of extremes, where animals turn danger into opportunity.

Follow Africa's youngest animals as they take their first steps. Through stunning landscapes and close-up encounters, discover how courage, family bonds and resilience shape survival during the most fragile stage of life in the wild.
When humans collide with a carnivore or a sea creature, pain can ensue.
Rookie Terje's in big trouble when he crashes Thord's tow-truck. Bjoern heads out to rescue a forty-tonner which overturned into a snow ditch.
A mixed news bulletin which keeps viewers updated with the current affairs.
Showcasing stories of resilience and groundbreaking efforts, exploring how individuals and communities shape change through courage, strength, and hope.
India Global will be your window to the world where we will decode New Delhi's diplomatic moves and positions on global issues in a world that is seeing constant geopolitical shifts.
The host presents big interviews, debates and all the election news.
India Matters: Where the day's biggest stories get Shiv Aroor's sharp, unsparing take.
Nidhi Razdan has a discussion on young leaders and communal politics.
Deep Dive into issues that matter to you most. Empowering you with content & context.
Watch TV programmes and films instantly.
Hard-hitting analysis and opinion on the latest news and events delivered.
Former NY Mayor Rudy Giuliani gives insight on leadership, courage and the most pressing issues of our time.
Judge Napolitano provides commentary on current events, drawing on his expertise in constitutional law to protect individual freedoms.
Rob Carson dissects politics, cultural phenomena and the absurdity confronting America with humor and satire.
Unlike any president who has come before him, Donald J. Trump is a commander-in-chief who doesn't just go off-script, sometimes he just goes off.
A comprehensive update, offering a dynamic blend of breaking news, political developments and business insights.
Rick Leventhal delivers comprehensive analysis and interviews on current affairs and significant events from home and abroad.
An investigation into science, economics, and narratives driving today's climate debate. Viewers are challenged to consider what is known, what remains uncertain, and why open inquiry matters.
Colorized archival footage vividly captures D-Day, the decisive Allied invasion that changed the course of World War II.
Rarely-seen footage and expert interviews are used in this documentary series.
Looking at the numerous missteps that turned the Axis powers' devastating victories into crushing defeats.
A look back at the most wild presidential election in modern times, with an eye-opening analysis of Trumps relationship with the media.
Stay informed with the breaking news and headlines.
Live national headlines, expert interviews and insight into the stories shaping America.
John Bachman tackles big news from DC, NY and around America.

Paddington and the Browns rescue pufflings, who get lost around the campsite instead of taking their first flight. Paddington enjoys a diving adventure with Jonathan and Judy - but where is her necklace?

The beach is a mess, but all the litter must be cleared up in time for the beach party that everyone has been looking forward to. As the summer holidays come to an end, the time arrives to say goodbye to new friends.
Paddington wants to make a special cake. Paddington and Mateo form a table tennis team.
The bath tap at the Little Castle is dripping, so the elf plumber is called. It's a bigger job than first expected, but with King and Queen Marigolds coming round, there's not much time.
Mr Elf has built a new boat to replace the one Big Bad Barry ate. He is nervous when the king commands him to take them on a cruise to a tropical paradise.

There's a pirate-themed holiday in town, but Zuma isn't in a festive mood. His revamped persona gets tested when a real pirate arrives, bent on hidden treasure and ready to destroy the town to get it!
PAW Patrol is a CG action-adventure preschool series starring a pack of six heroic puppies led by a tech-savvy 10-year-old boy named Ryder.
Tim tries to be at two parties at once.
Tim and Tommy go on a camping trip but soon disagree on what to do first.
Blaze, AJ, and Starla are on their way to a Wild West Picnic. But when the Lunchbox Bandit steals everyone's lunchboxes, it's up to our Wild West Heroes to get them back.
A tiny top hat delivery leads to a dazzling day for new magician Baby Box; meanwhile, her closest friends help her perform a boppin'-and-hoppin' trick.
Snooty King and Queen Marigold are coming to visit, but when the King's new clothes get dirty Nanny cleans them, along with the King's old clothes and shrinks them all.
Holly breaks her wand and must go to the Wand Factory, at the bottom of the Great Elf Tree, to get it fixed.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!
Peppa and her family go to the water park for an adventure, and Miss Rabbit is in charge. There are lots of fun things to do at the water park, but the first thing to do is to put on a swimsuit.
Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure.

Madame Gazelle takes the class through a simple tots workout at Peppa's playground that uses spinning hoops. Though they have fun playing with the hoops, they have a hard time spinning them around their waists as directed.
Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside, and build a very large sandcastle with all their friends.
Farmer hires Willow's pet carnivorous plant to watch over his crops. Papa Smurf prepares a potion to boost his strength, but its effects are heavily altered due to a spider's intrusion.
Sid Swashbuckle pretends to be a legendary ghost so that he can take Danny's new skateboard; Ryder and the Pups race to save Mayor Goodway's Glow-in-the-Dark Party.
Rubble dreams that he's been taken aboard a spaceship and meets his alien double; the Pups must save Humdinger and his kittens when they mess around with Blinky the Clown's tiny clown car.
Mica's Marsup journal ends up in Acu's bag, so he has to get it back before his friend finds it. Twister is fed up with Hope and Punch's pranks, so he builds his own cardboard house which Stan finds.
Out looking for Gaston, after banning him from the castle, the elves and fairies come across a speaking door which leads to the dwarf mine. Once in, they find they can't get out.
Using magic, Holly makes Lucy small enough to play in the Little Kingdom. Lucy has fun flying on Gaston the Ladybird and is invited to a sleepover at the Little Castle.
King Thistle wants bread for his royal breakfast, but there isn't any flour in the castle. Mr Elf takes everyone to the Elf Windmill to find out why it takes so long to make flour.
When Grandma gives Tim a hat she made herself, Tim is super excited, but unfortunately it keeps getting in the way.
Tim tests new rocket boots, which quickly spiral out of control.
Tim and Tia build a time machine to avoid confronting Dad and telling him the truth.
Stan is intrigued when he spots strange lights in the night sky. Grumblestunk thinks it's an alien invasion, but Stan and Gran are not so sure.
A fish has gone missing from Grandad's pond and his plastic 'scare' heron appears to have come to life! Stan and Gran suspect something fishy is going on!
An air collie makes an unlikely friend. The Creature Catchers try a new ploy.

Peppa and George are watching a television show about Detective Potato and how he helps people find things. Daddy needs to buy some gravel so Peppa and George go with him. They park the car in a very large car park, but when they return, they can't remember where they parked it. Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel arrive to help Daddy Pig but have no luck. Suddenly, Detective Potato appears and saves the day.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival, a jigsaw festival. Peppa learns the secrets of puzzles from Grandma Donkey.
Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tour of an exercise park. Since the machines are only for grownups, the kids do funny exercises instead.
Peppa and her family enjoy the apple tree at the top of the hill. It has a swing on it that they all like to swing on and Peppa has a special song for it.

In this special episode, Speed Meister sabotages a speeding train, accidentally sending it towards a huge mountain! Rubble and Crew introduce their new demolition vehicles to smash through the mountain and build a tunnel to save the day!

When Maverick the daredevil Pterodactyl takes a tumble and hurts his wing, the pups are there for a sky-high Dino Rescue. A volcano is erupting, threatening the Dino Wilds! It's all paws on deck for a massive Dino Rescue.
Gabby and Pandy share their new Meow Meow Mail with Cakey and work on a cure for a case of the hiccups.
Madame Gazelle teaches the children how to play the recorder. They practise a lot at home, then put on a performance for all the parents to enjoy.
Everybody is once again skiing on the mountains, but an unpredictable Mummy Pig showcases her skiing skills.
Madame Gazelle sets the children a creative task of making masks. There are carrot masks, robot masks, and even pretty butterfly masks. The only thing missing is lots and lots of glitter.

Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete. Peppa, Mummy and George all decide to go with Daddy and enjoy a train journey, where they sing to pass the time.

Peppa and her friends head to the trampoline park where Miss Rabbit shows them how to bounce. As Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Mummy Sheep watch the children play, they decide they want to have a go at trampolining.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy!

Peppa and her family are watching television when it suddenly stops working. While Grampy Rabbit attempts to repair it, the family acquires a new, multifunctional TV. However, they soon realise their old set was preferable.
The elf and fairy children learn all about how the rubbish from a picnic can be recycled into beautiful new toys.
Ben is in training for the elf games, and Holly wants to join in but the rules state there is absolutely no flying or magic allowed. Ben gives Holly a chance to join in without using magic.
When Thomas and Percy transport an unlucky boxcar of bananas, Thomas starts to have bad luck wherever he goes and must find a way to break the curse.
When Nia causes an accident that sends sand into Tess's gears during a big delivery, Nia tries Sandy's new super-grease as a solution.
Join Tim Rex, brother Tommy, sister Tia, and Triceratops bestie Kai as they tackle kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions! Tim, Tommy, Tia and Dad get stuck on a remote asteroid.
Tim has a clear out of all his old stuff but soon finds not all of it is destined for the rubbish tip.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tia's new balloon gets stuck in a tree, so Tim tries to get it down.
Paddington has to decide whether to support England or Peru before the football match, but he loves both countries. It's time for Aunt Lucy to go home, but there's still time for one last adventure.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandma, Peppa and George go to the shed to see what Grandpa is doing and discover that he's built a robot.
Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
Mum, Dad, Peppa and George decide to go to the beach on a beautiful sunny day. Suddenly, a little cloud covers the sun for a minute, but then it passes and the sun reappears.
Ben and Holly are excited when they learn that Nanny Plum is a Tooth Fairy at night. They go along with her to pick up a little girl's tooth, but the little girl is not so little.
When Captain Squid leaves his treasure map in the Little Kingdom, Redbeard the Elf Pirate leads Ben, Holly and Nanny Plum on a treasure hunt.
Peppa and her friends visit Mrs Badger's petting farm, where they enjoy feeding the chickens and meeting cute guinea pigs.
Peppa's family embarks on an adventure, but Daddy Pig's fear of heights threatens their climb to the monkey tree.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.

Mummy Pig takes Peppa to the doctors for her yearly health check-up with Dr Polar Bear, who checks her height, weight, ears, mouth and heartbeat and listens to Mummy tell him all about the changes Peppa has gone through.
Peppa and her friends visit the cinema for the first time to watch the 'Super Potato' film.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa's house and have a fun dinosaur party.
Peppa helps out with Danny Dog refurbishing his bedroom, and imagines a pirate adventure along the way.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
Peppa and her friends are at their clubhouse. They decide to start a detective club, and when Daddy Pig loses his car keys, they have a real mystery to solve.
While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre.
Mummy Pig shows Peppa how to play pretend by teaching her how to wink. Zoe Zebra comes to play with Peppa and brings along her toy monkey. Peppa pretends Monkey has a cough.
Peppa and her family go bowling at the Peppatown Bowling Alley.
Peppa and her friends visit a roller disco organised by Madame Gazelle. After skating along to nursery rhymes, they go wild to the rhythm of the music together with Madame Gazelle.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.
Peppa and George join Grandma Piggy and her friends to play a game pretending to be Vikings. The Vikings enjoy Grandpa Piggy's boat until they realise they forgot about the picnic.
Peppa learns that Mummy Pig used to keep a diary when she was her age, so Peppa decides to give it a try.
PC Panda brings his twin daughters to playgroup Peggy and Pandora Panda. They love puzzles and to solve mysteries just like their dad.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig. Grandpa builds a special hiding hut to watch birds in so they can all go owl-spotting.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.

Doctor Hamster comes to school to talk about butterflies. Doctor Hamster shows the children some colourful caterpillars and all the children draw pictures of caterpillars. One caterpillar forms a chrysalis that opens to reveal a pretty butterfly. The children paint butterfly wings and dance the life cycle of a butterfly.
Grandpa Pig hides some pirate treasure in his garden, and when Peppa and George come, they have to look for it, using a map and following the clues.
When the family goes to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house for dinner, George is reluctant to eat his salad.

After Peppa's tooth falls out, Mummy Pig explains that the Tooth Fairy will come that very night to take the tooth and leave a shiny coin in its place. Peppa plans to stay awake all night to see the Tooth Fairy.

It's time for playgroup, and Peppa and friends are thinking about what they want to be when they grow up. Some in the group want to be nurses, police officers and even pirates, but Peppa takes a little while to figure out what she wants to be.
Grandpa Pig pops round with some seeds for Peppa and George to plant, with Daddy Pig helping out by acting as a scarecrow.

Peppa and George love jumping in muddy puddles, even when it's raining, but when George takes off his rain hat he catches a cold. After plenty of rest and some warm milk and honey, George begins to feel much better.

Grandpa and Granny Pig show and share with Peppa and George their toys and hobbies. Granny shows her special doll from childhood and Grandpa his love of building toy planes. Peppa and George have great fun when Grandpa reveals his new biggest plane ever that even George can fit in.

Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to school on their scooters. When he decides that it would be quicker to ride back, he discovers that riding scooters is great fun. Mummy Pig thinks that they are fun too and they both ride the scooters.

George eats his breakfast too quickly and gets hiccups, so Peppa tries to help him get rid of them. After trying everything else, there is only one solution left for Peppa to cure him with - to scare him!
Peppa's playgroup is putting on a play, and Peppa is going to be Little Red Riding Hood.
When Mummy Pig helps out at Miss Rabbit's fire station, she is called upon to douse the flames at Daddy Pig's out-of-control barbecue.
Zoe Zebra delivers a very special letter for Peppa and George, an invitation to her birthday party.
Peppa and her family visit a new theme park where there is lots of fun to be had with vegetables.
Peppa's friend Pedro wears glasses, and Peppa thinks she might need them too, so Mummy Pig takes her to the optician.
Tiddles gets stuck in a tree and needs to be rescued. When the turtle falls on Pedro's nose, he needs to go to the doctors to make sure everything is OK.
Daddy Pig reads Peppa and George a bedtime story to help them fall asleep. When George wakes up again, Peppa has to make up a bedtime story to get him back to sleep.

Mummy Pig shows Peppa and her friend Suzy Sheep some old photographs from when they were babies. Peppa and Suzy don't remember being that young, but they are pleased to see that they have always been best friends.
It's bedtime, but Peppa is not sleepy, so Daddy Pig tells Peppa and George a story about a pretty princess and a dinosaur.
Daddy Pig has a book from the library that he has kept for too long. The family go to the library to return it and find more books to read.
Peppa and George go sailing with Grandpa Pig, but when he keeps getting stuck in the mud, they all decide to have a sleepover on the boat while they wait for the tide to come back in.
When Daddy Pig needs a new watch, Mr Fox finds three grandfather clocks in the back of his van. Three clocks are much better than one. Mr Fox has everything in his van, even a chicken.
Peppa and George want to be famous detectives like their favourite television programme 'Detective Potato', so Daddy Pig gives them a mystery to solve.

It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited. That can only mean one thing, soft play. George and friends have great fun, swinging, bouncing and climbing, but it isn't quite as much fun for the grown-ups.
Peppa and George meet Kylie Kangaroo and her brother Joey. Peppa shows Kylie how to jump up and down in muddy puddles, and they see who can jump the highest.
Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George go to the park. Peppa and George play on the hopping logs, the bouncing branch and the monkey bars.
When Daddy Pig is given a parking ticket, Peppa and George learn that adults have rules just like children - and that they get told off too.
When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
With the building work complete, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their new attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick?
Peppa and George are re-enacting the Apollo Moon Landing with the help of Granny Pig's friends. Grampy Rabbit lends them his rocket, but no one has told him it's just pretend.
When George loses the metal wind-up key for his toy robot in the long grass, Grandpa Pig cannot find his metal detector to help George track it down.
Peppa and her friends have fun while painting in the playgroup. Madame Gazelle then teaches them how to play games with parachutes.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy!
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.
Peppa and George check out Grandpa's new Bug Hotel as lots of insects arrive. A bumblebee cannot find a place in the hotel because the rooms are too small for him.

Madame Gazelle presents the poetry to Peppa and her friends, explaining that sounds can also be poems. When it starts raining, the inspired children create a beautiful poem about the rain and recite it to their parents.
At playgroup, Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead Peppa and her friends in a wonderfully fun musical Kiddie Workout.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.
Peppa, George, Granny and Grandpa Pig visit the sailing club where they find a juke box. They have fun dancing to all different types of music.
The playgroup is going on an outing to the museum. Everyone is on the bus ready to go, except Pedro Pony, so where is he?
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.

Peppa, George and Daddy Pig are excited about Mummy Pig's birthday and have lots of fun preparing surprises for her. When Mummy Pig sees her beautiful cake and opens her present, she is absolutely delighted.
At Peppa's playgroup, Madame Gazelle wants everyone to show the class their special talent.

Peppa and George's toy basket is full, and their beds are covered in toys, so Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. The cupboard arrives in the post, but it needs to be assembled - and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is at hand, as Mr Zebra the Postman loves assembling flat-pack furniture.

Mummy Rabbit comes to visit with a big tummy. Everyone is excited to find out there is a baby rabbit inside, but they are in for an even bigger surprise! The children think of ideas for names beginning with 'R.'

Grandpa and Granny Pig take Peppa, George and all their friends on a boat trip to Pirate Island. On the island, Grandpa shows everyone how to use his metal detector to find treasure, and they all build a big sandcastle.

Peppa and family have all gone to the caves for a day out and Grampy Rabbit is their tour guide. Peppa and George are excited to see the pretty caves and go through the underground lakes. Daddy Pig must be at his bravest on this trip to go on the scary 'Ride of Doom'.
Miss Rabbit takes Peppa and the family to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house to drop off their shopping, but that's not the last trip of the day for her.
Teddy needs mending and cleaning after rolling down hills and jumping in muddy puddles, so Peppa takes her to Miss Rabbit's Doll Hospital.
Granny and Grandpa Pig have a beautiful little boat, and Peppa and George are spending the day on the river with them.

It is school project time for Peppa and her friends, which means they have to build castles and bring them into playgroup. Mummy and Daddy Pig have lots of fun helping Peppa make hers, if only they could find the glitter.
Peppa and her playgroup friends go with Madame Gazelle to visit Pedro Pony, who is poorly in hospital.

It is time for a day out and Peppa, George, Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Suzy Sheep all go to visit Tiny Land. They see tiny dinosaurs, their favourite tiny landmarks and even a tiny Miss Rabbit doing even more jobs.
Peppa and George help Mummy Pig tidy up the breakfast things. Mummy Pig teaches them how to recycle the bottles and newspapers, then they take everything to Miss Rabbit at the recycling plant.
Peppa and her family visit a museum, and Peppa likes the Kings and Queens room, whereas George's favourite is the dinosaur room.
Peppa's family is staying at Cousin Chloe's house. It's been a long day and everyone is tired and sleepy, but baby Alexander keeps everyone awake with his crying.
When Grandpa Pig puts up a tent in his garden, Peppa and her friends decide that it's a perfect place to put on a circus. With Peppa as the ringmaster, the show can begin.
Peppa and George are playing in the garden when they hear a strange noise. It's thunder. Peppa and George are a little bit frightened at first but Peppa soon decides that she loves thunderstorms.
Peppa and her family spot a rainbow when they go for a drive.
Peppa and her family are trying to get to the playground, but Mr Bull's roadworks are in the way.
Granny and Grandpa's pet Polly Parrot comes to stay, and Peppa and George love Polly Parrot. But when she flies away, no one knows what to do.
Grandpa Pig has built a fantastic little train called Gertrude, and when they take a ride, they give all their friends a ride.
When Peppa goes for a sleepover at Zoe Zebra's house with Suzy Sheep, Rebecca Rabbit, Candy Cat and Emily Elephant, the girls are too excited to go to sleep.
It's nighttime at Grandpa and Granny Pig's house, and Peppa and George have stayed up late to help hunt for slugs and snails. But what other night animals will they find?
Peppa and George make everyone laugh when they dress up as Mummy and Daddy Pig.
When Daddy Pig loses his glasses he gets a bit grumpy, but Peppa and George have lots of fun looking for them.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her friends on a train ride where they must tick off what they see on their activity sheets.
Peppa and family go on a walk through the forest where they meet all of their favourite fairytale characters. They visit the home of bears who like porridge and meet a hungry Mr Wolf.
Peppa and all her friends at playgroup dress up as different countries from all over the world.
Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail.
Peppa and Suzy Sheep are best friends, but one day they have a quarrel over a game of cards and decide they are not best friends any more.
When the school roof is broken and needs fixing, Peppa volunteers Mummy Pig to do a parachute jump to raise money. Daddy Pig goes up too, and has to overcome his fear of heights.

Mummy Pig's book is finished, and it's time to show it off to Peppa and her playgroup friends. Unfortunately, Peppa and George lose some of the book when they are playing, and Mummy Pig has to think quickly to fix it.
Peppa and George love going to the beach on sunny days. They bring their water wings, a beach ball and buckets and spades. Peppa and George have fun burying Daddy Pig in the sand.
Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send Polly Parrot for help when their boat runs aground. Polly fetches Granny Pig and Grandad Dog to rescue them.
Peppa and her friends and family are looking forward to a trip to the seaside where they can make sandcastles, but when they arrive at the beach there is too much snow.
Mrs Zebra teaches Peppa, George, Zoe, Zaza and Zuzu Zebra how to make a real tea set from clay.
Madame Gazelle takes the class to London for the day, where they are given a tour of the city by none other than the Queen of England.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her school friends on a school bus trip to the mountains. From the top of the mountains, there is a fantastic view, and Peppa and her friends have fun hearing echoes.
Playgroup is having a pet competition and everyone has brought their pets. Dr Hamster is the judge, but it is so hard to choose the best pet.
Peppa and her friends are playing pirates, but when they put together a treasure chest and bury it in a marked spot, Pedro soon realises that he needs to follow the trail. He's lost something.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are going out for the evening. Granny and Grandpa Pig babysit Peppa and George. They are too excited to sleep. When Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig get home everyone is asleep.
Peppa and Luzie Locke find that adults have to work all the time. The children imitate the elders, in the shop and on the playground. They realise that playing can be really hard work.
Peppa and her friends learn how to count by playing games at Madame Gazelle's playschool.
Madame Gazelle gives the class a music lesson. There's lots of crashing and banging at first, but it's not long before the grown-ups visit and lay down some notes of their own.
George has fun making bubbles, and Peppa has fun popping them.

Eine Rockerband ist auf dem Weg nach Bikini Bottom und SpongeBob will alle warnen. Aber Mr. Krabs sieht darin sofort ein Geschäft. Die Tang-Sake ist das neue Lieblingsgetränk in Bikini Bottom. Mr. Krabs und Plankton wollen an das Rezept kommen.

SpongeBob muss sich auf die weite Reise zum Geheimversteck der Geheimformel machen, weil in der Krossen Krabbe die Krabben Burger ausgehen. Er muss dafür mit dem Ozeanien-Express fahren, doch er ist nicht allein auf seiner Reise.

Dora erfährt, dass ihre Großmutter nie eine Quinceañera hatte. Daraufhin beschließt sie, eine Überraschungsparty für sie zu organisieren. Währenddessen sucht Coco den Großen-Geschichten-Baum auf, weil ihr keine Geschichte einfällt.

Tim sucht einen Ort in Dinostadt, an dem er alleine Spaß haben kann. Tim und Kai wollen für Parky den besten Tag aller Zeiten organisieren. Als ein Sturm die Rexes zu Hause hält, denken sie sich ein Spiel aus, um sich die Zeit zu vertreiben.

In der Nachbarschaft macht ein neuer Lebensmittelladen auf. Bobbys Familie muss sich etwas einfallen lassen, um der Konkurrenz standhalten zu können. Ronnie Anne täuscht eine Krankheit vor, damit sie einen Lucha-Libre-Wrestlingkampf sehen kann.

1. Geschichte: Der entspannte Bootsausflug der Familie auf einem See endet auf einer einsamen Wüsteninsel. Können sich die Louds von der Insel retten? 2. Geschichte: Lincoln und Clyde sind davon überzeugt, dass eine Tiefkühlkostfirma die Rezepte von Lincolns Vater stiehlt. Klar, dass die beiden als Ace und Jack ermitteln müssen!

Nachdem die Stars die Nachbarin Gladys zur Weißglut treiben, zeigt sie ihr Vigilanten-Ich, die Street Sweeper, und bestraft Bikini Bottom. Daraufhin aktivieren die Stars ihre Superhelden-Ichs, die Super Stars.
Pat wird geholfen, einen neuen Job zu finden. OpaPat überzeugt Patrick, sein Zuhause zu verlassen.

Nachdem die Wohnung zufriert, nimmt Lou an der Vermieterkonferenz teil und Papier will alle retten. In einem Prank-Battle stellen sich Schere, Stein und Papier gegen die Ratten-Bros und Bleistift. Doch Bleistift hat eine geheime Waffe.
Das Trio macht sich gemeinsam auf den Weg, um sieben Limetten von Pipers Schwester zu bekommen.

Als SpongeBob und Patrick sich Nachrichten per Muscheln schicken, gerät Thaddäus ins Chaos. SpongeBob glaubt, eine neue Allergie zu entwickeln, nachdem er bereits seinen millionsten Krabbenburger auf der Arbeit zubereitet.

Als der Zirkus in die Stadt kommt und seine Kunden stiehlt, versucht Mr. Krabs, die Show zu sabotieren. / Sandy verbringt den Tag damit, die Probleme aller zu lösen, kehrt dann aber nach Hause zurück und hat plötzlich eigene Probleme.
Um zu einer Food-Messe zu kommen, muss die Krosse Crew sich in der Wildnis durchschlagen. SpongeBob muss den Schein wahren, als ihn ein Brieffreund besucht, den er vorher angeschwindelt hat.

SpongeBob würde sich sehr über Besuch von Thaddäus freuen, doch dieser hat keine Lust darauf. Doch SpongeBob überlegt sich einen raffinierten Trick, sodass er doch bei ihm vorbeischaut. Dann sieht er SpongeBobs neue Möbel.
Carl und Adelaide könnten die Überraschungsparty verderben. Bobby testet eine neue Geschäftsidee.

Nachdem er CJs beeindruckende Twist-Akrobatik gesehen hat, hilft Par CJ beim Training für einen Werbeschild-Wirbel-Wettbewerb. Als Adelaide einen Zahn verliert, erzählen ihr Carl und Bobby von El Raton, der lateinamerikanischen Zahnfee.

Lucy will einen Vampir, der nach Royal Woods gezogen ist, überreden, sie und ihre Freunde ebenfalls in Vampire zu verwandeln. Zudem geht es darum, dass Lucy im Hinterhof Dinoknochen gefunden hat, doch entpuppen sie sich als etwas anderes.
Shane findet keinen Anschluss an seinem ersten Tag an der Royal Woods High und bittet Leni, Luna und Luan um Hilfe.

Lola und Lana müssen einige Prüfungen bestehen, um bei den Bluebells aufgenommen zu werden. Loris Freund Bobby trifft sich mit anderen Mädchen. Lincoln und Clyde verfolgen ihn, um herauszufinden, was er vorhat, und ihn zu überführen.

Thaddäus stiehlt SpongeBobs Tagebuch und liest in der Krossen Krabbe daraus vor. Dafür wird er verstoßen. Mr. Puff will um jeden Preis, dass SpongeBob die Fahrprüfung besteht, doch in letzter Sekunde geht doch noch etwas schief.

In der Krossen Krabbe ist eine Seeigel-Plage ausgebrochen und SpongeBob, Mr. Krabs und Plankton versuchen, sie zu bekämpfen. Thaddäus will von Sandy und SpongeBob Karate lernen, ist aber ein schlechter Schüler.
Nachdem Plankton es geschafft hat, aus dem Gefängnis auszubrechen, ist sein erstes Ziel, die Krabbenburger-Geheimformel zu stehlen.

Papier und Bleistift erzählen einen Witz und versuchen das Gefühl, damit gut anzukommen, immer wieder zu erleben. Schere engagiert ein Orchester, das ihn begleitet und sein Leben mit Musik vertont, um eine berühmte Freundin zu beeindrucken.
Die Show bekommt konkurrierende Sponsoren; die Familie Star besucht den Palast von Neptun.

Pinky beschließt, dass es einen König des Schulballs geben muss und stellt seinen Mitschülern folglich mehrere Herausforderungen, die von seiner Lieblingsserie 'Schlacht um die Krone' inspiriert sind. Wer wird der König des Herbstballs werden?

Die Louds reisen gemeinsam nach Neapel, denn sie wollen die beste Pizza der Welt probieren. Gebacken wird diese aber von einer geheimniskrämerischen Köchin. Lori und Leni helfen Lynn mit einem Jungen in den Schweizer Alpen zu sprechen.

Als der Bus der Louds eine Reifenpanne hat, dürfen sie im mysteriösen Schloss eines unheimlichen Paares übernachten. Bei einer Besichtigung des Parthenons setzt Lincoln einen Kriegerhelm auf, der ihn ins antike Griechenland befördert.

Lincoln und seine Freunde versuchen, sich mit Kara, der Neuen, anzufreunden, als sie erfahren, dass sie an ein legendäres, verschollenes Comic-Heft kommt. Miguel bittet Leni um Hilfe, um seine eigene Parfum-Marke bei Reininger herauszubringen.
1. Geschichte: SpongeBob putzt den Leuchtturm der Bootsfahrschule. Dort findet er einen süßen Kameraden. 2. Geschichte: In Bikini Bottom ist niemand sicher vor dem ansteckenden Schluckauf.

Perla unternimmt mit ihren Freundinnen einen Ausflug zu einer Hütte in den Wäldern. Sie erleben zusammen ein Wochenende voller lustiger und alberner Streiche. Mr. Krabs hat ein geheimes Verlangen nach etwas ganz Speziellem.
Ein Zoo besteht aus Seifenblasen und die Krosse Krabbe muss sofort in Quarantäne gehen.
Als ein kleiner Clown von einem Zirkus zurückgelassen wird, kümmert sich SpongeBob um ihn.
While the Boss Baby helps Tim sell magazines for a school fundraiser, a suspicious baby whisperer seeks to break up the playgroup.
The stage is set for corporate sabotage as Staci sends the Boss Baby undercover to take down Baby Corp's latest leader at a company retreat.

Paper and Sandpaper are on a train that gets hijacked by The Algebra Villain, who will make them crash unless Paper solves an algebra problem. Rock and Scissors think of the perfect prank call, but Rock bails to watch Franz Roll's pet, Kitty.
After capturing the Lawnies' attention, SpongeBob and Squidward become a hit new live act. After Cecil stumbles into a pile of underwear, he becomes an underwear salesman.

Squidward and Bubble Bass are forced to tolerate each other's company on a trip to Shell City; Squidward takes a trip inside the imagination box and must rely on SpongeBob and Patrick's creativity in order to escape.

Theodore helps Simon to try and get past his perfectionism in order to complete an art assignment for art class. Simon has a crush on the babysitter and secretly prepares a romantic dinner while Theodore keeps Alvin distracted.
Someone snatches all the fruit from an orangutan's island in the jungle; the agents try to bring some peace to a pair of brawling Gila monsters.
Animated, Children, Action, Adventure, Science, Educational
The twins and Marsupilamis save an egg from the Jaguar, which hatches into a baby crocodile. The Marsupilamis are helping people, and Callie wants to find out who the Amazing Coat Man hero is.
A glowing lantern leads Gabby and Pandy to a Fairy Fly House; however, to meet their new neighbour, they'll need to prove they're helpful, kind and welcoming.

Lily and Farmer have to save the village from a slobbering monster. Gargamel transforms Rowena into a Smurfette in an attempt to capture Smurfs, but Mummy begins adoring her because she reminded her of her doll from her childhood.
Tempers flare when the Chipmunks get stuck in traffic on the way to a show. Simon becomes annoyed by constant requests to fix things and plays dumb until he gets a thank-you.

Brittany's dream of being a fashion designer turns into a nightmare when she gets a job and her ideas are stolen. Alvin suspects Dave of being a local bank robber when Dave starts acting suspiciously and giving the boys gifts.

Scissors thinks he's finally discovered his thing when he joins forces with the sleep-themed villain Dreamscape. Rock is sick and can't lead the Robo Car Wash in the Car Wash Nationals dance competition, leaving it to Paper and Scissors.

Rock, Paper and Scissors have a great time birdwatching until they return home to find the birds have started watching them; the trio discovers they're trapped in a nightmare and must wake up before one of them wets the bed.

Halmoni feels she looks helpless about technology, so she becomes a master hacker and vows to destroy their internet FOREVER! Lily must retrieve a book from the dreaded library: a horrifying maze of unknown terrors.
The Chaos Council returns to New Yoke City more powerful than ever, forcing the rebels to come out of the shadows and bring a fight to their front door.

When Alvin thinks Theodore's teddy bear can tell the future, Alvin goes all out to make Talking Teddy his friend. Alvin lies to Theodore about a fake holiday to get out of chores, so Dave forces Alvin to make the holiday real.

Jeanette decides to plant a garden on the school grounds, but Bo Carter manages to install vending machines instead. When Alvin finds a treasure map in Miss Croner's basement, the chipmunks set off in search of lost treasure.

Paper and Pencil inadvertently create a horde of Rock clones and decide to look after them together. Rock, Paper, and Scissors find a genie, but just as they're about to make their wish, his 1,000-year curse runs out, and he can no longer grant it.
After Pat the Hapless moves in next door, Patrick and SpongeBob help him find a job. GrandPat convinces Patrick to run away from home.

When customers bring pets into the Krusty Krab, Mr. Krabs soon realises pets are more profitable than owners; Plankton ruins another date with Karen, so she puts the Chum Bucket on lockdown until he proves his affection.

In an attempt to get out of the dentist, Lily insists on a summer celebration of the fall holiday Chuseok. When Will accidentally befriends an annoying man, his sorry attempts at a break-up make things painfully awkward for the whole family.
Max misses being famous and having fans, so he decides to break Booch's sandwich-stacking record to be famous again; Chloe rallies behind Booch, so that she can take back her record.
VMA-winner Alex Warren hosts the slime event of the year, where we celebrate your favourite stars from film, television, music, sports and social media.

When Chloe's dangerous new power emerges, she's ordered to superhero boarding school. The family divides as Phoebe, Barb and Billy hide with her, while Max, Hank and Nora pursue them, leading to a battle over their future.
